items.title: 格上租車共享車版圖拓至中台灣 Go Smart插旗台中機場
items.title_en: Go Smart Expands Shared Car Service to Central Taiwan with New Taichung Airport Station
paras: 裕隆集團旗下格上租車今(14)日宣布，旗下共享車品牌Go Smart持續擴大國內機場周邊自助租還服務，於臺中國際機場正式啟用「台中機場站」，共享車機場服務版圖也正式拓展至中台灣。
格上租車說明，旅客可於北中部7縣市(台北、新北、基隆、桃園、宜蘭、新竹、台中)任一站租還據點取車，直接前往台中機場站還車；或於機場取車後，依行程需求彈性歸還至其他縣市站點。
據交通部民航局統計，臺中國際機場今年國際及兩岸航線數已突破30條，全年運量可望挑戰300萬人次，隨著區域機場運量成長，共享車提供跨縣市彈性取還，將是滿足機場周邊用車需求的關鍵條件。
格上租車觀察到，機場旅運量攀升同步帶動周邊彈性用車需求成長，無人化取還、跨區異站租還等服務型態，正逐漸成為共享車市場的重要指標。
目前格上共享車在全台19縣市已開設近1,500站，車隊規模3,000台，共導入7品牌、15款車型，車型橫跨都會小車、休旅車款至純電車，也是國內共享車市場率先導入純電車輛的品牌，而跨區租還服務涵蓋北中7縣市，並未額外收取跨區費用，旅客可透過App靈活於區域內的異站租還站點取還車，全程無需臨櫃辦理，24小時隨時取還、還車地點也不限於原租車站點。
paras_en: Yulon Group's Go Smart car‑sharing brand announced today that its self‑service rental and return stations around domestic airports are expanding, with the official launch of a "Taichung Airport Station" at Taichung International Airport, extending its airport service footprint into central Taiwan.

Go Smart explains that travelers can pick up a car at any of the seven stations in northern and central counties and cities (Taipei, New Taipei, Keelung, Taoyuan, Yilan, Hsinchu, Taichung) and drop it off directly at the Taichung Airport station, or they can pick up at the airport and later return the vehicle to any other station according to their itinerary.

According to the Civil Aviation Administration, Taichung International Airport has already exceeded 30 international and cross‑strait routes this year, with annual passenger traffic expected to approach 3 million. As regional airport traffic grows, the flexibility of cross‑city pick‑up and drop‑off offered by shared cars will be a key factor in meeting the transportation needs around airports.

Go Smart observes that rising airport passenger volumes are driving increased demand for flexible, on‑demand vehicle use nearby, and services such as unmanned pick‑up/return and cross‑region station rentals are becoming important indicators in the shared‑car market.

Currently, Go Smart operates nearly 1,500 stations across 19 counties and cities in Taiwan, with a fleet of about 3,000 vehicles spanning seven brands and 15 models—from compact city cars and SUVs to pure‑electric vehicles. It is the first domestic shared‑car brand to introduce electric cars, and its cross‑region rental service covers the seven northern and central counties without extra fees. Users can book via the app to pick up and drop off at any station within the area, all without visiting a counter, 24 hours a day, and the drop‑off location does not have to be the original rental station.

items.title: 加拿大人抵制美國貨 促使加國超市重塑供應鏈
items.title_en: Canadians Boycott U.S. Goods, Prompting Canadian Supermarkets to Reshape Supply Chains
paras: 隨著美國與加拿大之間的貿易戰加劇，加拿大消費者自發性發起「購買國貨、抵制美貨」的運動，正深刻重塑該國超市的貨架布局與供應鏈結構。
這波抵制浪潮起因於去年美國總統川普對加國商品加徵關稅，近幾周因貿易談判破裂及川普簽署行政命令試圖將安大略湖改名為「美國湖」，而進一步升溫。
面對消費者的強烈訴求，加拿大各大零售商紛紛調整營運策略以因應轉變。例如，加拿大最大的食品零售商 Loblaw 重新在生鮮區豎立楓葉標籤，並導入「T」字標籤告知顧客哪些商品受到關稅影響；第三大超市 Metro 也強調將持續優先採購本土產品。
其中，安大略省獨立超市 Vince's Market 門市內的加拿大農產品比例，已提高至 90%，草莓改從魁北克進口，但也坦言平衡品質、價格與產地帶來了營運成本壓力。此外，部分業者如 Mike Dean Local Grocer 則轉向西班牙、巴西及宏都拉斯等國採購，以打造更多元安全的供應鏈。
數據顯示，加拿大從美國進口的蔬菜比例已從2023年7月的69%降至今年同期的62.6%。為減輕對進口的依賴並抑制食品通膨，加拿大政府宣布將在未來10年投入約 30億加幣 興建溫室。
專家分析，儘管目前「民族主義超越了經濟效益」，且省際法規限制增加了跨省運輸難度，但若未來美加關係有所緩和，價格優勢仍可能使部分採購轉回美國。
paras_en: As the trade war between the United States and Canada intensifies, Canadian consumers have spontaneously launched a “Buy domestic, boycott U.S.” campaign, profoundly reshaping supermarket shelf layouts and supply‑chain structures in the country.

The boycott wave stems from last year’s tariffs imposed by U.S. President Trump on Canadian products, and has heated up in recent weeks after trade talks collapsed and Trump signed an executive order attempting to rename Lake Ontario as “Lake America.”

Facing strong consumer demand, major Canadian retailers are adjusting their operating strategies. For example, Canada’s largest food retailer Loblaw has reinstated a maple‑leaf label in its fresh‑produce section and introduced a “T” tag to inform shoppers which items are affected by tariffs; the third‑largest chain Metro also emphasizes that it will continue to prioritize domestic sourcing.

At Vince’s Market, an independent grocery in Ontario, the share of Canadian farm products on the shelves has risen to 90%; strawberries are now sourced from Quebec, though the store admits that balancing quality, price and origin adds operational cost pressure. Meanwhile, some operators such as Mike Dean Local Grocer have turned to Spain, Brazil and Honduras to build a more diversified and secure supply chain.

Data show that the proportion of vegetables Canada imports from the United States has fallen from 69% in July 2023 to 62.6% for the same period this year. To reduce reliance on imports and curb food inflation, the Canadian government announced it will invest about C$3 billion over the next ten years to build greenhouses.

Experts note that although “nationalism now outweighs economic efficiency” and inter‑provincial regulations have made cross‑province transport harder, a future easing of U.S.–Canada relations could restore price advantages and cause some sourcing to shift back to the United States.

paras: 一、盤勢結構：季線震盪測試，殺盤後出現低接承接

台股今日呈現「開低震盪、殺低後收斂」格局，盤中一度下挫786點、回測季線附近，終場跌322點、收45,862點，成交量縮至約6,331億元，顯示恐慌性賣壓雖然出籠，但追殺力道並未持續擴大。
短線最大壓力仍來自美債殖利率、油價及Fed政策不確定性，但指數回測季線後已有低接買盤承接，若季線能持續守穩，則本波較偏向「多頭架構中的技術性修正」，尚不能直接視為中期多頭反轉。
操作上反而應留意「指數弱、個股強」的結構性行情，震盪期間資金更容易集中至具備基本面、訂單能見度及產業趨勢的AI供應鏈。


二、基本面：出口創歷史新高，AI需求仍是台股最大底氣

台灣8月出口達824億美元、年增41%，創歷年單月新高；1～8月出口累計5,743.4億美元、年增44.2%，AI、半導體及資通訊產品仍是出口成長核心動能。
這代表目前台股面對的主要問題仍偏向「資金面與評價面震盪」，而非基本面需求突然反轉；只要AI伺服器、ASIC、HBM、高速網通及先進製程需求持續，台灣電子供應鏈獲利成長仍有支撐。
因此，本波拉回反而提供市場重新檢視企業基本面的機會，後續關鍵不在指數跌多少，而在「哪些公司能持續賺錢」。


三、Fed與油價：短線最大變數，但未必等於中期空頭

Fed將於美東9月15～16日召開FOMC會議，目前市場對是否升息仍高度分歧；近期通膨與油價確實提高政策風險，但Reuters最新調查顯示，多數經濟學家預期9月及今年剩餘時間維持利率不變，因此「升息確定論」仍需保留。
若會議結果低於市場最悲觀預期，反而可能形成「利空落地、資金回流」行情；反之，若政策訊息更加鷹派，則台股仍可能維持高波動。
油價突破100美元則是另一項重要風險，但目前美國製造業與服務業仍維持擴張，企業獲利才是全球股市中期趨勢的核心支撐。


四、AI主軸：由先進製程進一步延伸至CPO與高速互連

SEMICON Taiwan 2026釋放的產業訊號相當明確：AI/HPC需求正在推動晶片由單純「製程微縮」走向「先進封裝＋高速互連＋系統整合」。官方論壇已將CPO、3DIC、Chiplet、HBM、散熱及測試列為AI下一階段關鍵技術。
CPO的核心價值，在於因應GPU、ASIC運算能力提升後的頻寬、功耗與延遲瓶頸，因此後續值得關注光通訊、光引擎、主動對位、光學量測、探針卡及Final Test等供應鏈。
投資主軸可由傳統AI伺服器進一步擴大至「CPO＋矽光子＋高速傳輸＋先進封裝測試」，尋找下一波產業成長曲線。


五、台積電(2330-TW)擴產：先進製程與設備耗材仍是中長線主軸

台積電持續擴大2奈米、3奈米與先進封裝產能，市場最新供應鏈訊息指出，2027年中2奈米月產能可能由今年底約9萬片提升至11萬片，3奈米則由逾18萬片增加至21萬片。相關數據目前屬供應鏈訊息，台積電並未正式確認。
台積電官方及公開產業資訊則已明確顯示，AI需求正推動先進製程與先進封裝持續擴產；公司預期2奈米產能2026～2028年將以約70% CAGR成長，CoWoS與SoIC亦維持高速擴張。
因此，中長線仍可鎖定半導體設備、耗材、先進封裝、PCB、散熱、記憶體、CPO、功率半導體及PMIC等具實際需求支撐的族群。


六、投資策略：指數震盪不悲觀，選股重於選市

目前最重要策略不是追價，而是「逢回找強、汰弱留強」；對短線漲幅過大的高估值個股應避免追高，反而可趁市場恐慌時尋找基本面尚未被破壞、股價已充分修正的AI受惠股。
選股優先順序建議鎖定：①實際AI訂單、②營收持續成長、③獲利能見度高、④產業趨勢明確、⑤估值仍具合理性。
總結而言，目前台股最大的風險仍是Fed、油價與國際資金面，但最大的優勢則是AI需求、台灣出口與半導體產業競爭力。只要季線未有效跌破、基本面未出現明顯反轉，這波震盪更適合視為「籌碼重新洗牌」而非全面撤退訊號。


結論：短線看季線、中線看基本面、長線看AI。行情震盪時不要被指數牽著走，真正值得留意的，是下一批「獲利開始加速、但市場尚未完全反映」的AI供應鏈。

paras_en: 1. Market structure: Seasonal line oscillation test, after a sell-off a low‑level support emerges

2. The Taiwan market today displayed a pattern of “opening low, oscillating, selling low, then converging.” During the session it fell 786 points, tested near the seasonal line, and closed 322 points lower at 45,862, with trading volume shrinking to about 633.1 billion NTD, indicating that while panic selling was released, the follow‑on selling momentum did not continue to expand. The main short‑term pressure still comes from U.S. Treasury yields, oil prices and Fed policy uncertainty, but after the index tested the seasonal line there was buying support at the low. If the seasonal line can hold, this wave is more likely a “technical correction within a bullish structure,” and should not yet be seen as a mid‑term bullish reversal. Traders should instead watch for a “weak index, strong stocks” structural trend; during oscillations funds are more likely to concentrate on AI supply‑chain companies with solid fundamentals, order visibility and industry trends.
3. Fundamentals: Exports hit a record high, AI demand remains the biggest confidence for Taiwan stocks

4. Taiwan’s August exports reached US$82.4 billion, up 41% YoY, a new monthly record; cumulative exports from January to August were US$574.34 billion, up 44.2% YoY, with AI, semiconductors and ICT products still the core growth drivers. This indicates that the main issue facing Taiwan stocks is still a “funding and valuation oscillation” rather than a sudden reversal of fundamental demand. As long as demand for AI servers, ASICs, HBM, high‑speed networking and advanced process technology continues, profitability growth for Taiwan’s electronic supply chain remains supported. Thus, this pullback actually offers the market an opportunity to re‑examine corporate fundamentals; the key is not how much the index falls, but which companies can keep earning.
5. Fed and oil: Short‑term variables, but not necessarily a mid‑term bearish trend

6. The Fed will hold its FOMC meeting on September 15‑16 in the U.S. East; markets remain highly divided on whether rates will rise. Recent inflation and oil prices do increase policy risk, but Reuters’ latest survey shows most economists expect rates to stay unchanged for September and the rest of the year, so the “rate‑hike certainty” thesis still needs to be reserved. If the meeting outcome is below the most pessimistic market expectation, it could trigger a “bad‑news landing, capital outflow” scenario; conversely, if the policy signal is more hawkish, Taiwan stocks may still experience high volatility. Oil breaking $100 is another important risk, but U.S. manufacturing and services are still expanding, and corporate earnings are the core support for mid‑term global equity trends.
7. AI focus: From advanced process to CPO and high‑speed interconnect

8. SEMICON Taiwan 2026 released a clear industry signal: AI/HPC demand is driving chips from pure “process miniaturization” to “advanced packaging + high‑speed interconnect + system integration.” The official forum lists CPO, 3D‑IC, chiplet, HBM, cooling and testing as key technologies for the next AI phase. CPO’s core value lies in addressing bandwidth, power and latency bottlenecks after GPU and ASIC performance improvements, so the optical communication, optical engine, active alignment, optical metrology, probe card and final test supply chains are worth watching. Investment focus can expand from traditional AI servers to “CPO + silicon photonics + high‑speed transmission + advanced packaging testing,” seeking the next industry growth curve.
9. TSMC (2330‑TW) expansion: Advanced process and equipment remain the long‑term focus

10. TSMC continues to expand 2‑nm, 3‑nm and advanced packaging capacity. Latest supply‑chain information suggests that by mid‑2027, 2‑nm monthly capacity could rise from about 90,000 chips this year to 110,000, and 3‑nm from over 180,000 to 210,000. These figures are currently supply‑chain rumors; TSMC has not officially confirmed them. Public industry data shows that AI demand is driving continuous expansion of advanced process and packaging; the company expects 2‑nm capacity to grow at about 70% CAGR from 2026‑2028, and CoWoS and SoIC to maintain rapid expansion. Thus, the long‑term focus remains on semiconductor equipment, consumables, advanced packaging, PCB, cooling, memory, CPO, power semiconductors and PMIC—groups with real demand support.
11. Investment strategy: Market oscillation is not pessimistic, stock selection matters more than market selection

12. The most important current strategy is not to chase prices, but to “buy on pullbacks, weed out the weak and keep the strong.” High‑valuation stocks with large short‑term gains should be avoided; instead, look for AI beneficiaries whose fundamentals have not been destroyed and whose prices have fully corrected during market panic. Stock‑selection priority should be: 1) real AI orders, 2) continuous revenue growth, 3) high earnings visibility, 4) clear industry trend, 5) reasonable valuation. In summary, the biggest risk for Taiwan stocks remains the Fed, oil and international capital, while the biggest advantage is AI demand, Taiwan exports and semiconductor competitiveness. As long as the seasonal line does not break effectively and fundamentals do not reverse, this oscillation is better viewed as a “re‑shuffling of chips” rather than a signal to retreat entirely.

13. Conclusion: Short‑term look at the seasonal line, medium‑term at fundamentals, long‑term at AI. During market oscillation, don’t let the index dictate your moves; the real focus should be on the next batch of AI supply‑chain companies whose profits are accelerating but the market has not yet fully reflected them.

items.title: AI行業「撒謊」太久？Anthropic CEO談放緩AI研發：AI風險是真的、但無需「把一切都關掉」
items.title_en: Has the AI Industry Been "Lying" About Risks for Too Long? Anthropic CEO on Slowing AI Development: AI Risks Are Real, but No Need to "Turn Everything Off"
paras: 在全球人工智慧（AI）三大巨頭罕見聯手呼籲「放緩AI研發」的同一個週末，Anthropic執行長Dario Amodei近日接受《CBS》節目《Sunday Morning》專訪，談及AI快速發展可能帶來的風險。他表示，目前已有人嘗試利用AI研發生物武器、提升病毒傳播能力，這類威脅已成為他每天都必須面對的問題。
Amodei指出，Anthropic日前發布的一份威脅情報報告，便涉及有人濫用AI模型進行生物武器研發。
他坦言，自己當然不希望Anthropic的模型被用於造成傷害，因此公司在生物學相關能力上採取非常嚴格的安全防護措施。
他甚至提到，Anthropic的生物安全限制嚴格到經常遭到社群嘲諷，部分生物學學生也抱怨模型「沒辦法使用」。
不過，Amodei強調，與其因為安全措施受到嘲笑，他更不願看到有人利用Claude造成大規模傷亡。
週末，Amodei發表的一篇部落格文章《我們必須為尖端AI踩剎車》（We Must Pace the Frontier）引發軒然大波，並隨即獲得馬斯克、OpenAI執行長Sam Altman相繼公開支持。

AI發展進入「變陡」階段 Amodei：這是警告訊號

主持人Jo Ling Kent在訪談中直接問Amodei，AI是否真的可能在不久的將來導致人類滅亡。Amodei並未認為眼下需要陷入恐慌，但他認為目前確實出現值得重視的警訊。
他以指數成長曲線形容AI技術發展，從1、2、4、8、16、32一路上升，目前已進入曲線開始快速變陡的階段。Amodei坦言，即使自己長期提醒外界AI進步速度可能非常快，真正面對如此快速的進展時，仍比預期更加震撼。
因此，他主張AI產業應該適度放慢尖端模型的發展速度，但這並不代表要關閉AI產業或停止技術研發。
Amodei認為，真正需要確保的是，AI的安全防護、理解能力與控制能力必須跟得上技術進步。如果模型能力持續快速提升，但人類對風險的理解及控制手段沒有同步進步，便可能形成問題。

Amodei提三步方案 第三方評估員成關鍵

針對如何降低AI風險，Amodei進一步說明他提出的三階段方案，其中最重要的一步，是引入嵌入式第三方評估機制。
他主張，可以由第三方非營利組織，甚至未來由政府機構派遣評估人員，觀察AI模型從訓練到運作的完整流程。他將這類人員比喻為食品安全檢查員，但也承認，AI技術進步速度如此之快，第三方評估機制本身也必須考量能否跟上。
Amodei認為，評估員能夠跟上的速度，本身就可能成為決定AI技術推進速度的因素之一。
第二步則是由多家AI業者共同建立安全標準，包括模型發布及技術推進的安全標準。不過，他認為若要真正落實，政府也必須參與其中。
第三步則是政府正式進入這場對話。Amodei表示，當討論涉及AI產品應以多快速度發布、這樣的速度是否安全時，政府必須在場。

「AI終止開關」未必有效 Amodei主張多層防線

對於國會議員Ted Leo提出的「AI終止開關」法案，Amodei表示自己尚未詳細研究法案內容，但對「終止開關」概念本身抱持保留態度。
他認為，能夠限制、停用或關閉AI模型固然是一種手段，卻不能被視為唯一解方。若AI模型強大到一定程度，甚至可能具備規避人類關閉嘗試的能力，而Anthropic在模擬環境中也曾觀察到類似情況。
Amodei因此以「瑞士起司模型」說明他的安全理念：單一安全措施就像一片存在漏洞的瑞士起司，無法完全阻擋風險；但若建立多層防線，各層漏洞位置不同，風險便較難穿透整個體系。
他強調，沒有任何單一措施能夠完全防範AI風險，因此必須在整個AI開發與部署鏈條上維持警戒。
至於參議員Bernie Sanders與眾議員Greg Casar提出、主張「禁止超級人工智慧法案」，Amodei則明確反對全面禁止AI的方向。
他認為，若完全禁止這類技術，人類也將無法獲得AI可能帶來的重大好處，包括醫療領域的突破，這是他無法接受的結果。

父親死於丙肝、本人曾罹癌 Amodei談AI帶來的另一面

談到AI可能影響人類未來的風險與責任時，Amodei也罕見分享自己的家庭與健康經歷。
他表示，自己的父親因丙型肝炎去世時，這種疾病的治癒率約為40%，父親並未成為成功治癒的患者；但就在父親過世幾年後，一種新藥問世，將治癒率提高至約95%。
Amodei也透露，自己曾罹患早期癌症。如果生活在1950年，他可能已經因此死亡。
正因如此，他深刻體會到推動AI發展、讓科技帶來醫療等領域突破的重要性，但另一方面，也同樣感受到技術失控可能造成的風險。
他強調，這不應該成為自己或Anthropic單獨承擔的責任，而是涉及整個社會。他希望能找到一套機制，讓所有人都能參與相關討論，而不是讓一般民眾感到幾家科技公司可以自行決定AI未來。

回應前員工批評 Amodei：我們面對的是同一個結構性問題

對於前Anthropic員工Jacob Coxin公開批評Anthropic與OpenAI沒有負責任地行事、甚至是在拿人類生命冒險，Amodei則認為，外界引用相關言論時忽略了其中另一個部分。
他表示，Coxin同時認為Anthropic是主要AI業者中較為負責任的一家，而他所指出的核心問題，其實與Amodei目前提出的警告相同，也就是所有AI公司共同面臨的結構性困境。
Amodei表示，他提出的三階段方案正是希望處理這種結構性問題。
他並透露，Anthropic每天都與美國商務部、財政部及情報界官員溝通，並向政府部門分享公司掌握的資訊。

Amodei：AI產業對風險「說謊太久」

對於一般正在使用Claude、ChatGPT等AI工具的民眾，Amodei表示，AI本身仍是一項具有大量正面用途的重大技術，目前每週都有數億人利用相關技術完成各種事情，他也經常收到使用者來信，表示Claude協助發現醫師未能診斷出的疾病。
不過，他強調自己不會對使用者隱瞞AI存在的風險。
Amodei認為，AI產業過去太長時間都以非常正面的方式呈現這項技術，對相關風險避重就輕。他主張，面對AI快速發展，第一步就是必須誠實告訴大眾風險確實存在。
他最後表示，AI是人類歷史上最重要的技術事件之一，因此不能只由少數科技公司決定其發展方向，而應該讓所有人參與其中。
paras_en: On the same weekend that the three global AI giants unusually joined forces to call for a "slow‑down of AI research," Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei recently appeared on CBS's "Sunday Morning" to discuss the risks of rapid AI development. He said that people are already trying to use AI to develop bioweapons and enhance virus transmissibility, threats he now faces every day.
Amodei noted that Anthropic recently released a threat‑intelligence report that documented misuse of AI models for bioweapon research.
He admitted that, of course, he does not want Anthropic's models used to cause harm, so the company has implemented extremely strict safety safeguards around any biology‑related capabilities.
He even mentioned that Anthropic's bio‑security restrictions are so strict they are often mocked by the community, and some biology students complain the model "doesn't work for them."
Nevertheless, Amodei stressed that rather than being laughed at for safety measures, he would rather not see anyone use Claude to cause mass casualties.
Over the weekend, Amodei's blog post "We Must Pace the Frontier" sparked a firestorm and quickly earned public support from Elon Musk and OpenAI CEO Sam Altman.

AI development has entered a "steepening" phase, Amodei says: This is a warning signal. Host Jo Ling Kent asked directly whether AI could realistically cause human extinction in the near future. Amodei said panic is not warranted now, but he believes there are warning signs that deserve attention.

He described AI progress as an exponential curve—1, 2, 4, 8, 16, 32—now entering a phase where the curve steepens rapidly. Amodei confessed that even though he has long warned about the speed of AI advances, the actual pace is more shocking than he expected.
Therefore, he argues the AI industry should moderately slow the development of frontier models, but this does not mean shutting down the industry or halting research altogether.

Amodei believes the real need is to ensure AI safety, interpretability, and control keep pace with technical progress. If model capabilities keep accelerating while human understanding of risks and control mechanisms lag, problems will arise.
Amodei outlined a three‑step plan to reduce AI risk, with third‑party evaluators being a key component.

He proposes that independent nonprofit organizations—or eventually government‑appointed assessors—monitor the entire lifecycle of AI models from training to deployment. He likens these assessors to food‑safety inspectors, while acknowledging that the rapid pace of AI may challenge the evaluators' ability to keep up.
Amodei says the speed at which evaluators can keep up could itself become a factor that determines how fast AI technology moves forward.

The second step calls for multiple AI firms to jointly establish safety standards covering model releases and technical progress, though he notes that genuine implementation will require government participation.

The third step brings the government formally into the conversation. Amodei says that when discussions involve how quickly AI products should be released and whether that speed is safe, the government must be present.
Regarding Congressman Ted Leo's proposed "AI kill‑switch" legislation, Amodei said he has not studied the bill in detail but remains skeptical of the kill‑switch concept itself.

He believes that while the ability to limit, suspend, or shut down an AI model is a tool, it cannot be the sole solution. If a model becomes powerful enough, it may develop ways to evade human shutdown attempts—a behavior Anthropic has observed in simulated environments.

Amodei uses the "Swiss cheese model" to illustrate his safety philosophy: a single safety measure is like a slice of Swiss cheese with holes that cannot fully block risk; multiple layers with differently placed holes make it much harder for risk to penetrate the whole system.
He stresses that no single measure can completely prevent AI risk, so vigilance must be maintained across the entire AI development and deployment chain.
As for Senator Bernie Sanders and Representative Greg Casar's proposed "Ban Super‑AI" legislation, Amodei is clearly opposed to an outright ban on AI.
He argues that a total prohibition would deprive humanity of AI's huge benefits, such as breakthroughs in medicine, a result he finds unacceptable.
When discussing AI's potential impact on humanity's future, Amodei also unusually shared personal family and health experiences.

He said his father died of hepatitis C, a disease that at the time had a cure rate of about 40 % and his father was not among the cured; a few years after his father's death, a new drug raised the cure rate to roughly 95 %.
Amodei also disclosed that he once had early‑stage cancer and that, had he lived in 1950, he likely would have died from it.
Because of this, he deeply appreciates the importance of advancing AI to enable medical breakthroughs, while also feeling the weight of potential risks from uncontrolled technology.

He emphasizes that this responsibility should not fall solely on him or Anthropic, but on society as a whole. He hopes to create mechanisms that let everyone participate in the discussion rather than leaving the future of AI in the hands of a few tech firms.

Responding to former Anthropic employee Jacob Coxin, who publicly criticized Anthropic and OpenAI for irresponsible behavior and risking human lives, Amodei said outsiders often miss another part of the story when quoting those remarks.

He noted that Coxin also considers Anthropic one of the more responsible AI companies, and that the core issue Coxin highlighted aligns with Amodei's own warning: a structural dilemma faced by all AI firms.
Amodei said his three‑stage proposal is intended to address this structural problem.
He also revealed that Anthropic communicates daily with officials from the U.S. Department of Commerce, Treasury and intelligence agencies, sharing the company's insights with the government.

Amodei: The AI industry has "lied" about risk for too long. For everyday users of Claude, ChatGPT and similar tools, he says AI remains a major technology with huge positive uses; hundreds of millions of people each week rely on it for a variety of tasks, and he often receives messages from users saying Claude helped detect diseases that doctors missed.
However, he stresses that he will not hide the existence of AI risks from users.

Amodei believes the AI industry has presented the technology in an overly positive light for far too long, downplaying associated risks. He argues that the first step in confronting rapid AI development is to honestly tell the public that risks truly exist.
He concludes that AI is one of the most important technological events in human history, and its direction should not be decided solely by a handful of tech companies but should involve everyone.

items.title: 創見攻高速運算 推64GB工業用DDR5
items.title_en: Inventec Launches High-Speed Computing, Offers 64GB Industrial DDR5
paras: 創見(2451-TW)今(14)日宣布，推出DDR5-6400 CUDIMM與CSODIMM工業用記憶體模組，提供單條64GB高容量，滿足邊緣AI、智慧製造、工業自動化及高效能嵌入式系統的運算需求。
創見表示，該產品採用DDR5雙通道架構與1.1V低工作電壓設計，搭載CKD (Client Clock Driver)時脈驅動器，可減少高速運作時因雜訊與抖動造成的訊號干擾，提升訊號穩定性；同時整合電源管理晶片(PMIC)，強化供電效率與電壓控制。SPD晶片內建溫度感測器，可即時監控記憶體溫度；搭配瞬態電壓抑制器(TVS)，可降低電壓不穩對元件造成的損害。
此外，DDR5記憶體顆粒內建On-Die ECC除錯機制，有助於提升資料完整性與長時間運作可靠性，為新一代工業運算平台提供兼具高容量、高效能與穩定性的記憶體解決方案。
創見DDR5-6400 CUDIMM與CSODIMM提供單條64GB高容量，滿足工業電腦、邊緣運算設備及嵌入式系統的高負載運算需求。模組採用DDR5雙通道架構，有效提升資料存取效率與整體傳輸效能；搭配DDR5-6400高速規格，可加速大量資料交換與即時運算，為高效能工業應用提供充足的記憶體容量與頻寬。
針對高速運作時的訊號穩定需求，模組搭載CKD時脈驅動器，可重新驅動並調整主機端傳送的時脈訊號，減少高速運作時因雜訊與抖動造成的訊號干擾，提升訊號完整性與穩定性，支援新一代高速運算平台，確保工業系統在高速、高負載、長時間運作及大量資料傳輸情境下，持續維持穩定可靠的運算效能。
在電源管理方面，此系列產品採用1.1V低工作電壓設計，有助於降低整體功耗與發熱量，適用於空間、電力及散熱條件受限的工業設備。模組亦整合電源管理晶片(PMIC)，可直接於模組端進行電源調節與分配，提升供電效率及電壓控制精準度，降低電源波動對記憶體運作的影響，進一步強化系統整體穩定性。
paras_en: Inventec (2451-TW) announced today, September 14, that it is launching DDR5‑6400 CUDIMM and CSODIMM industrial memory modules, each offering a single‑stick capacity of 64 GB to meet the computing demands of edge AI, smart manufacturing, industrial automation and high‑performance embedded systems.

Inventec says the products use a DDR5 dual‑channel architecture and a low 1.1 V operating voltage, and incorporate a CKD (Client Clock Driver) clock driver to reduce signal interference caused by noise and jitter during high‑speed operation, improving signal stability; they also integrate a power‑management IC (PMIC) to enhance power‑delivery efficiency and voltage control. An SPD chip with a built‑in temperature sensor can monitor memory temperature in real time, and a transient voltage suppressor (TVS) helps mitigate damage from voltage instability.

In addition, the DDR5 memory chips include an on‑die ECC debugging mechanism that helps improve data integrity and long‑term reliability, providing a memory solution for next‑generation industrial computing platforms that combines high capacity, high performance and stability.

The Inventec DDR5‑6400 CUDIMM and CSODIMM modules provide a single‑stick capacity of 64 GB, satisfying the high‑load computing needs of industrial PCs, edge‑computing devices and embedded systems. The modules employ a DDR5 dual‑channel architecture that effectively boosts data access efficiency and overall transfer performance; paired with the DDR5‑6400 high‑speed specification, they accelerate large data exchanges and real‑time processing, delivering ample memory capacity and bandwidth for high‑performance industrial applications.

To address signal‑stability requirements during high‑speed operation, the modules feature a CKD clock driver that re‑drives and adjusts the clock signals sent from the host, reducing noise‑ and jitter‑induced interference, enhancing signal integrity and stability, and supporting next‑generation high‑speed computing platforms. This ensures that industrial systems maintain stable and reliable performance under high‑speed, high‑load, long‑duration and massive data‑transfer scenarios.

Regarding power management, this product series uses a low 1.1 V operating voltage to help lower overall power consumption and heat generation, making it suitable for industrial equipment with limited space, power and cooling conditions. The modules also integrate a PMIC that can perform power regulation and distribution directly on the module, improving power‑delivery efficiency and voltage‑control precision, reducing the impact of power fluctuations on memory operation and further strengthening overall system stability.

items.title: 通訊行：iPhone18 Pro預約量較上代成長4%  官網交期已排到雙十連假
items.title_en: Telecom: iPhone 18 Pro Pre‑orders Up 4% YoY, Official Site Delivery Slots Booked Through Double‑Ten Holiday
paras: 蘋果(AAPL-US)最新智慧型手機iPhone 18 Pro系列與首款摺疊機iPhone Duo於9/10正式發表，並分別於9/18及10/23正式販售。隨著各大電信業者與經銷通路陸續開放預約，傑昇通信也啟動預約活動，根據傑週末兩天累積的訂單數量指出，今年僅能預約iPhone 18 Pro系列，預約量較去年同期些微成長4%，官網交期已經排到了10月中旬。
根據傑昇通信統計自9/12、13日開放預約以來的數據顯示，在各款新機的預約比例中，選擇預約登記iPhone 18 Pro Max的果粉比例最高，顏色以新色勃根地紅為主要選擇，而iPhone 18 Pro則是以新色冰川藍次之，兩款皆是256GB容量最受歡迎。
傑昇通信表示，即便今年iPhone 18 Pro系列新機的平均定價大幅上漲約17%，詢問度仍然相當高，且今年預約量實際較去年成長４％不輸以往，後續的整體買氣將隨第四季消費旺季的到來持續攀升。
面對iPhone 18 Pro系列因全球記憶體晶片成本急遽飆升、導致官方定價較前代調漲逾五千元的情勢，傑昇通信分析，在面對硬體成本轉嫁時，消費者更傾向靈活運用舊有裝置的剩餘殘值來填補價差，藉此以合理的實際支出取得新機。
傑昇通信門市今年選擇透過舊換新方案折抵購買新機的果粉比例已突破四成，不僅反映消費者對裝置回收機制的接受度大幅提升，更同步活絡二手機回收市場。
距離9/18開賣僅剩四天，傑昇通信觀察，蘋果官網首批到貨的數量與去年同期大致相符，若以蘋果官網在今（14）日的實際到貨狀況來看，iPhone 18 Pro各個容量與各種顏色均已排至10/2後才能陸續到貨，規格更高的iPhone 18 Pro Max各容量與各色，則需等待長達3至4週的時間，意味著大約要到雙十連假前後才能順利拿到新機，顯見蘋果新機的買氣依舊十分熱絡，未受價格上漲影響。
隨著第四季重點銷售檔期陸續到來，傑昇通信預期在開賣後，市場上對於高性價比舊機的搶購潮，也極有可能讓iPhone 17系列面臨現貨短缺的挑戰。
paras_en: Apple (AAPL-US) unveiled its latest iPhone 18 Pro series and its first foldable, the iPhone Duo, on September 10, with sales starting on September 18 and October 23 respectively. As carriers and retailers opened reservations, Jiesheng Communications launched its own booking campaign. Based on the total orders received over the weekend, only the iPhone 18 Pro series is available for reservation this year, with pre‑order volume up 4% compared with the same period last year, and the official website’s delivery schedule already pushed out to mid‑October.

Data from Jiesheng Communications since reservations opened on September 12‑13 show that among the new models, the iPhone 18 Pro Max attracted the highest share of Apple fans, with the new Burgundy Red colour being the most popular. The iPhone 18 Pro follows, with the new Glacier Blue as the second‑most chosen hue, and both models saw the 256 GB capacity as the most demanded.

Jiesheng Communications said that even though the average price of the new iPhone 18 Pro series has jumped about 17% year‑over‑year, consumer interest remains strong, and the 4% rise in pre‑orders this year matches previous performance. Overall demand is expected to keep climbing as the fourth‑quarter holiday shopping season arrives.

Facing a sharp rise in global memory‑chip costs that pushed the official price of the iPhone 18 Pro series up by more than NT$5,000 versus the previous generation, Jiesheng Communications analysed that consumers are more likely to offset the price gap by leveraging the residual value of their old devices, thereby acquiring the new phone with a reasonable out‑of‑pocket expense.

This year, more than 40% of customers buying a new iPhone at Jiesheng’s stores used the trade‑in program, reflecting a significant increase in consumer acceptance of device‑recycling schemes and simultaneously energising the second‑hand phone market.

With only four days left until the September 18 launch, Jiesheng observed that the first batch of stock arriving on Apple’s official site is roughly on par with the same period last year. As of today (the 14th), all iPhone 18 Pro capacities and colours are scheduled to arrive after October 2, while the higher‑spec iPhone 18 Pro Max variants will take 3‑4 weeks, meaning they won’t be available until around the Double‑Ten holiday. This indicates that demand for Apple’s new phones remains robust despite the price increase.

As the key fourth‑quarter sales period approaches, Jiesheng expects that after launch, a surge in demand for high‑value‑for‑money older models could lead to a shortage of iPhone 17 inventory on the market.

items.title: 台北晶華首發！35名印尼技術人力抵台 銜接房務接待即戰力
items.title_en: Taipei Regent Hotel Launches First Wave: 35 Indonesian Technical Workers Arrive in Taiwan to Join Hospitality Operations
paras: 因應少子化及超高齡社會帶來的產業缺工挑戰，勞動部自115年1月起推動「跨國技術人力精進方案」，並開放旅宿業引進外國技術人力。首波由台北晶華酒店聘僱的35名印尼籍外國技術人力，於今（14）日搭機抵台，由勞動部勞動力發展署跨國勞動力延攬中心副主任黃偉誠及駐台北印尼經濟貿易代表處代表艾吏福（Arif Sulistiyo）親自接機。這不僅是該方案推動後首批正式入境的旅宿業外國技術人力，也象徵台灣旅宿業海外人才延攬機制正式落地。

勞動部表示，台北晶華酒店於今（115）年8月13日順利取得首批35名印尼籍外國技術人力聘僱許可。本次抵台人員過去均曾在台北晶華酒店接受技能培育及實習，具備旅宿服務經驗，並熟悉台灣的工作環境及職場文化。業者透過「跨國技術人力精進方案」延攬表現優良的外國技術人力，除可縮短來台工作人員的教育訓練期間及工作適應期，使人員抵台後更快銜接房務、訂房及旅客接待等工作外，該批人力亦具備華語或英語等優勢，長期而言將有助台灣觀光產業發展。
勞動部強調，首批旅宿業外國技術人力順利抵台是重要里程碑。該方案並非單純增加外國人力，而是將提升本國勞工勞動條件與補充產業人力相互結合。旅宿業者只要為所聘僱最低薪的全時本國基層勞工加薪至少2000元，即可按照1：1的比例取得外國技術人力聘僱名額，透過「本國勞工加薪、外國技術人力補充」的制度設計，在協助業者填補人力缺口的同時，也讓本國基層勞工共享產業發展成果。
黃偉誠補充說明，台北晶華酒店取得聘僱許可後，國內許多旅宿飯店業者亦致電表達意願。截至115年8月底止，已超過60家旅宿業者申請辦理國內求才程序，累積求才需求人數超過600人，顯示該制度已逐漸受到業者重視，反映業界對穩定人力來源的實際需求。面對旅遊市場復甦及產業人力結構改變，勞動部與交通部將共同推動外國技術人力制度，協助旅宿業穩定服務量能、健全人力配置，並提升台灣觀光住宿服務的品質與韌性。
符合資格且有外國技術人力需求的觀光旅館及一般旅館業者，可積極運用「跨國技術人力精進方案」，至公立就業服務機構辦理國內求才，並申請資格認定及聘僱許可。相關資訊可至外國人勞動權益網站「外國技術人力專區」查詢。
paras_en: In response to labor shortages caused by low birth rates and an ultra‑aged society, the Ministry of Labor has been promoting the “Cross‑Border Technical Talent Advancement Program” since January 2022 and has opened the hospitality sector to foreign technical workers. The first batch of 35 Indonesian technical personnel hired by Taipei Regent Hotel arrived in Taiwan today (the 14th) by plane, greeted by Deputy Director‑General Huang Wei‑cheng of the Ministry’s Cross‑Border Talent Recruitment Center and Arif Sulistiyo, a representative of the Indonesian Economic and Trade Office in Taipei. This marks not only the first formal entry of foreign technical workers into the hospitality industry under the program, but also the official rollout of Taiwan’s overseas talent recruitment mechanism for hotels.

The Ministry of Labor said that Taipei Regent Hotel successfully obtained employment permits for the initial 35 Indonesian technical workers on August 13, 2022. All of the arrivals have previously received skills training and internships at the hotel, possessing hospitality service experience and familiarity with Taiwan’s work environment and workplace culture. By recruiting high‑performing foreign technical talent through the “Cross‑Border Technical Talent Advancement Program,” employers can shorten the training and adaptation periods for new staff, enabling them to quickly take on duties such as housekeeping, reservations, and guest reception. Moreover, this cohort’s proficiency in Mandarin or English will, in the long run, benefit the development of Taiwan’s tourism industry.

The Ministry emphasized that the smooth arrival of the first batch of foreign technical workers in the hospitality sector is a significant milestone. The scheme is not merely about increasing foreign labor; it aims to improve domestic workers’ conditions while supplementing industry manpower. Hospitality operators who raise the minimum monthly salary of their lowest‑paid full‑time local staff by at least NT$2,000 can obtain foreign technical worker permits on a 1:1 basis. This “local wage increase + foreign technical talent” design helps fill labor gaps while allowing local grassroots workers to share in the benefits of industry growth.

Huang added that after Taipei Regent Hotel secured its hiring permit, many other domestic hotels and resorts have expressed interest. By the end of August 2022, more than 60 hospitality operators had applied for domestic recruitment procedures, with a cumulative demand for over 600 workers, indicating growing recognition of the system and a clear industry need for stable labor sources. Facing a tourism market recovery and changes in labor structure, the Ministry of Labor and the Ministry of Transportation will jointly promote the foreign technical talent framework to help hotels maintain service capacity, achieve sound staffing, and enhance the quality and resilience of Taiwan’s tourism accommodation services.

Qualified hotels and inns that need foreign technical talent are encouraged to actively use the “Cross‑Border Technical Talent Advancement Program,” apply for domestic recruitment through public employment service agencies, and seek eligibility certification and hiring permits. Relevant information can be found on the Foreign Workers’ Labor Rights website’s “Foreign Technical Talent” section.

items.title: 瑩碩思覺失調症新藥完成全球首例給藥 搶進逾百億美元長效針劑市場
items.title_en: Ying Shuo Announces First Global Administration of New Schizophrenia Drug, Targeting a $10+ Billion Long‑Acting Injection Market
paras: 瑩碩(6677-TW)今(14)日宣布，旗下經美國FDA核准臨床一期試驗的思覺失調症新藥AX251已完成全球首例病患給藥，正式啟動國際人體臨床一期試驗，也象徵自主研發的「奈米晶針劑平台(NanoCIP)」技術邁向臨床驗證，未來可望搶攻思覺失調症長效針劑逾百億美元商機。
瑩碩說明，此試驗為多中心、開放性、劑量遞增暨劑量延伸設計的臨床一期試驗，將評估思覺失調患者單次注射AX251後的藥物動力學、安全性與耐受性。
根據Grand View Research預估，至2030年全球思覺失調症藥物市場規模將達112億美元，AX251即是瞄準這塊大餅。
瑩碩進一步點出，AX251所採用的化學小分子成分，目前全球僅有口服劑型上市，其原廠口服藥全球年銷售額達45.71億美元，儘管已有國際競爭者投入長效針劑開發，但公司的全球專利布局完整，加上獨家平台優勢及製程可放大性，具成為新一代抗精神病藥物潛力。
台灣市場方面，瑩碩則指出，台灣約有14萬名思覺失調症的剛性需求，政府也編列新台幣31億元的獨立預算，採用非總額支付試辦，並將長效針劑列為優先治療選項，可望直攻在地市場的政策紅利。
瑩碩8月營收9185.8萬元，月減7.79%，年增46.36%；累計今年前8月營收6.42億元，年增17.68%。
paras_en: Ying Shuo (6677‑TW) announced today, the 14th, that its schizophrenia drug AX251, which has received FDA approval for a Phase I clinical trial, has completed the world’s first patient dosing, officially launching the international Phase I human trial and marking the NanoCIP (Nano Crystal Injection Platform) technology—developed in‑house—on its way to clinical validation, with the prospect of capturing a multi‑billion‑dollar long‑acting injection market for schizophrenia.

The company explained that the trial is a multi‑center, open‑label, dose‑escalation and dose‑extension Phase I study that will evaluate the pharmacokinetics, safety and tolerability of a single AX251 injection in patients with schizophrenia.
According to Grand View Research, the global schizophrenia drug market is projected to reach US$11.2 billion by 2030, and AX251 is aimed directly at this sizable opportunity.

Ying Shuo further noted that the small‑molecule active ingredient in AX251 is currently available worldwide only in an oral formulation, whose original manufacturer records annual global sales of US$4.571 billion. Although international competitors are already developing long‑acting injectables, the company’s comprehensive global patent portfolio, exclusive platform advantage and scalable manufacturing process give it strong potential as a next‑generation antipsychotic.

Regarding the Taiwan market, Ying Shuo pointed out that roughly 140,000 patients in Taiwan have a rigid need for schizophrenia treatment. The government has allocated a separate NT$3.1 billion budget, piloting a non‑capitation payment model and prioritizing long‑acting injectables as a preferred therapy, which could unlock local policy incentives.

Ying Shuo reported August revenue of NT$91.858 million, down 7.79% month‑over‑month but up 46.36% year‑over‑year; cumulative revenue for the first eight months of the year reached NT$642 million, a 17.68% increase year‑over‑year.

items.title: 凱基人壽以運動助攻大健康 推廣體育文化
items.title_en: KGI Life Promotes Health Through Sports, Advancing Sports Culture
paras: 凱基人壽積極響應政府「健康台灣」政策，延續大健康布局，鼓勵民眾主動管理健康，將保險價值從傳統的風險保障延伸至健康促進，今年夏天，凱基人壽熱血贊助「第45屆新北威廉瓊斯盃國際籃球邀請賽」，以具體行動支持台灣體育與籃球發展。凱基人壽表示，運動不僅有助身心健康，也能凝聚並連結不同世代，期盼藉由支持體育賽事，協力推廣運動文化、打造全齡健康社會。

威廉瓊斯盃為亞洲具代表性的國際籃球賽事之一，本屆集結日本、韓國、美國等隊伍同場較勁，展現高水準競技實力，同時促進國際體育文化交流，中華隊男、女籃分別獲得季軍及亞軍佳績。凱基人壽除贊助賽事，也邀請保戶及內外勤同仁進場觀賽、齊聲應援。凱基人壽業務通路處副總經理黃柏仁擔任冠軍賽開球嘉賓；中場休息時，趣味互動鏡頭穿梭觀眾席，力邀球迷對著大螢幕揮手、比出「我願意+1」手勢及創意動作，品牌吉祥物凱基阿福也驚喜現身，與球迷同樂，現場笑聲與歡呼聲此起彼落，將球場熱情轉化為支持體育文化、擁抱健康生活的共同行動。
球場外，凱基人壽也攜手凱基文化藝術基金會及緯來電視網舉辦「小小主播體驗營」，帶領學童走進攝影棚，觀看美國職棒大聯盟賽事直播，認識主播、導播、攝影等幕前幕後工作，並體驗體育新聞播報與採訪流程，了解賽事轉播背後的專業分工。活動邀請味全龍球員拿莫·伊漾到場分享，讓孩子近距離接觸職棒選手，從運動員的故事中學習團隊合作、彼此信任及面對挫折不輕言放棄的精神，為未來的學習發展累積自信與韌性。

凱基人壽表示，未來會持續以「健康台灣 凱基同行」為方向，深化醫療、照護、康養與金融服務合作，並以「我願意+1」的行動文化，將數位、創新、永續與金融策略融入服務流程，從客戶真實需求出發，多想一步、整合更多資源，以「HWE健康財富專家（Health and Wealth Expert）團隊」為核心，串聯醫療、科技、家庭與社區，打造全齡健康生態圈，陪伴民眾從追求長壽邁向健康長壽，讓健康走進每一個家庭，為「大眾的健康+1」。
paras_en: KGI Life is actively responding to the government’s “Healthy Taiwan” policy, continuing its big‑health strategy and encouraging the public to take charge of their own well‑being. It expands the value of insurance from traditional risk protection to health promotion. This summer, KGI Life enthusiastically sponsored the 45th New Taipei William Jones Cup International Basketball Invitational, taking concrete action to support Taiwan’s sports and basketball development. KGI Life says that sport not only benefits physical and mental health but also brings together and connects different generations. By supporting sporting events, it hopes to help promote a culture of exercise and build a health‑focused society for all ages.

The William Jones Cup is one of Asia’s flagship international basketball tournaments. This edition featured teams from Japan, South Korea, the United States and others, showcasing high‑level competition while fostering cross‑border sports‑culture exchange. The Chinese men’s and women’s teams earned third‑place and runner‑up finishes respectively. In addition to sponsoring the event, KGI Life invited policyholders and staff—both on‑site and field‑based—to attend and cheer. Deputy General Manager of the Business Channel, Huang Bo‑ren, served as the opening‑game guest. During halftime, a fun interactive camera roamed the stands, urging fans to wave at the big screen, make the “I’m willing +1” hand sign and show creative moves. The company’s mascot, KGI A‑Fu, also made a surprise appearance, joining the fans in laughter and cheers, turning the arena’s energy into a collective push for sports culture and a healthy lifestyle.

Outside the arena, KGI Life partnered with the KGI Cultural and Arts Foundation and WeiLai TV to host a “Little Broadcaster Experience Camp.” The program led schoolchildren into a studio to watch live broadcasts of Major League Baseball games, learn about the roles of anchors, directors and cameramen, and try their hand at sports news reporting and interview procedures, gaining insight into the professional workflow behind event coverage. The event featured a guest appearance by Wei‑Chuan Dragons player Namo Yi‑Yang, giving the kids a close‑up encounter with a professional baseball player. Through the athletes’ stories, the children learned about teamwork, mutual trust and the perseverance to face setbacks without giving up, building confidence and resilience for their future learning and development.

KGI Life says it will continue to pursue the “Healthy Taiwan, KGI Together” direction, deepening cooperation among medical care, nursing, wellness and financial services. It will embed the “I’m willing +1” action culture, integrating digital, innovative, sustainable and financial strategies into its service processes, starting from customers’ real needs, thinking one step ahead and pooling more resources. Centered on the “HWE Health‑Wealth Expert” team, it will link healthcare, technology, families and communities to create an all‑age health ecosystem, accompanying people from merely seeking longevity to achieving healthy longevity, bringing health into every household and delivering a “Health +1 for the public.”

items.title: 格上租車共享車版圖拓至中台灣 Go Smart插旗台中機場
items.title_en: Go Smart Expands Shared Car Service to Central Taiwan with New Taichung Airport Station
paras: 裕隆集團旗下格上租車今(14)日宣布，旗下共享車品牌Go Smart持續擴大國內機場周邊自助租還服務，於臺中國際機場正式啟用「台中機場站」，共享車機場服務版圖也正式拓展至中台灣。
格上租車說明，旅客可於北中部7縣市(台北、新北、基隆、桃園、宜蘭、新竹、台中)任一站租還據點取車，直接前往台中機場站還車；或於機場取車後，依行程需求彈性歸還至其他縣市站點。
據交通部民航局統計，臺中國際機場今年國際及兩岸航線數已突破30條，全年運量可望挑戰300萬人次，隨著區域機場運量成長，共享車提供跨縣市彈性取還，將是滿足機場周邊用車需求的關鍵條件。
格上租車觀察到，機場旅運量攀升同步帶動周邊彈性用車需求成長，無人化取還、跨區異站租還等服務型態，正逐漸成為共享車市場的重要指標。
目前格上共享車在全台19縣市已開設近1,500站，車隊規模3,000台，共導入7品牌、15款車型，車型橫跨都會小車、休旅車款至純電車，也是國內共享車市場率先導入純電車輛的品牌，而跨區租還服務涵蓋北中7縣市，並未額外收取跨區費用，旅客可透過App靈活於區域內的異站租還站點取還車，全程無需臨櫃辦理，24小時隨時取還、還車地點也不限於原租車站點。
paras_en: Yulon Group's Go Smart car‑sharing brand announced today that its self‑service rental and return stations around domestic airports are expanding, with the official launch of a "Taichung Airport Station" at Taichung International Airport, extending its airport service footprint into central Taiwan.

Go Smart explains that travelers can pick up a car at any of the seven stations in northern and central counties and cities (Taipei, New Taipei, Keelung, Taoyuan, Yilan, Hsinchu, Taichung) and drop it off directly at the Taichung Airport station, or they can pick up at the airport and later return the vehicle to any other station according to their itinerary.

According to the Civil Aviation Administration, Taichung International Airport has already exceeded 30 international and cross‑strait routes this year, with annual passenger traffic expected to approach 3 million. As regional airport traffic grows, the flexibility of cross‑city pick‑up and drop‑off offered by shared cars will be a key factor in meeting the transportation needs around airports.

Go Smart observes that rising airport passenger volumes are driving increased demand for flexible, on‑demand vehicle use nearby, and services such as unmanned pick‑up/return and cross‑region station rentals are becoming important indicators in the shared‑car market.

Currently, Go Smart operates nearly 1,500 stations across 19 counties and cities in Taiwan, with a fleet of about 3,000 vehicles spanning seven brands and 15 models—from compact city cars and SUVs to pure‑electric vehicles. It is the first domestic shared‑car brand to introduce electric cars, and its cross‑region rental service covers the seven northern and central counties without extra fees. Users can book via the app to pick up and drop off at any station within the area, all without visiting a counter, 24 hours a day, and the drop‑off location does not have to be the original rental station.

items.title: Q4最大成長飆股、金居、台達電、光寶科、建榮、全友⊕
items.title_en: Q4 Highest Growth Stocks, Jinju, Delta Electronics, Lite-On, Jianrong, Quanyou
paras: 一、盤勢結構：季線震盪測試，殺盤後出現低接承接

台股今日呈現「開低震盪、殺低後收斂」格局，盤中一度下挫786點、回測季線附近，終場跌322點、收45,862點，成交量縮至約6,331億元，顯示恐慌性賣壓雖然出籠，但追殺力道並未持續擴大。
短線最大壓力仍來自美債殖利率、油價及Fed政策不確定性，但指數回測季線後已有低接買盤承接，若季線能持續守穩，則本波較偏向「多頭架構中的技術性修正」，尚不能直接視為中期多頭反轉。
操作上反而應留意「指數弱、個股強」的結構性行情，震盪期間資金更容易集中至具備基本面、訂單能見度及產業趨勢的AI供應鏈。


二、基本面：出口創歷史新高，AI需求仍是台股最大底氣

台灣8月出口達824億美元、年增41%，創歷年單月新高；1～8月出口累計5,743.4億美元、年增44.2%，AI、半導體及資通訊產品仍是出口成長核心動能。
這代表目前台股面對的主要問題仍偏向「資金面與評價面震盪」，而非基本面需求突然反轉；只要AI伺服器、ASIC、HBM、高速網通及先進製程需求持續，台灣電子供應鏈獲利成長仍有支撐。
因此，本波拉回反而提供市場重新檢視企業基本面的機會，後續關鍵不在指數跌多少，而在「哪些公司能持續賺錢」。


三、Fed與油價：短線最大變數，但未必等於中期空頭

Fed將於美東9月15～16日召開FOMC會議，目前市場對是否升息仍高度分歧；近期通膨與油價確實提高政策風險，但Reuters最新調查顯示，多數經濟學家預期9月及今年剩餘時間維持利率不變，因此「升息確定論」仍需保留。
若會議結果低於市場最悲觀預期，反而可能形成「利空落地、資金回流」行情；反之，若政策訊息更加鷹派，則台股仍可能維持高波動。
油價突破100美元則是另一項重要風險，但目前美國製造業與服務業仍維持擴張，企業獲利才是全球股市中期趨勢的核心支撐。


四、AI主軸：由先進製程進一步延伸至CPO與高速互連

SEMICON Taiwan 2026釋放的產業訊號相當明確：AI/HPC需求正在推動晶片由單純「製程微縮」走向「先進封裝＋高速互連＋系統整合」。官方論壇已將CPO、3DIC、Chiplet、HBM、散熱及測試列為AI下一階段關鍵技術。
CPO的核心價值，在於因應GPU、ASIC運算能力提升後的頻寬、功耗與延遲瓶頸，因此後續值得關注光通訊、光引擎、主動對位、光學量測、探針卡及Final Test等供應鏈。
投資主軸可由傳統AI伺服器進一步擴大至「CPO＋矽光子＋高速傳輸＋先進封裝測試」，尋找下一波產業成長曲線。


五、台積電(2330-TW)擴產：先進製程與設備耗材仍是中長線主軸

paras_en: 1. Market structure: Seasonal line oscillation test, after a sell-off a low‑level support emerges

2. The Taiwan market today displayed a pattern of “opening low, oscillating, selling low, then converging.” During the session it fell 786 points, tested near the seasonal line, and closed 322 points lower at 45,862, with trading volume shrinking to about 633.1 billion NTD, indicating that while panic selling was released, the follow‑on selling momentum did not continue to expand. The main short‑term pressure still comes from U.S. Treasury yields, oil prices and Fed policy uncertainty, but after the index tested the seasonal line there was buying support at the low. If the seasonal line can hold, this wave is more likely a “technical correction within a bullish structure,” and should not yet be seen as a mid‑term bullish reversal. Traders should instead watch for a “weak index, strong stocks” structural trend; during oscillations funds are more likely to concentrate on AI supply‑chain companies with solid fundamentals, order visibility and industry trends.
3. Fundamentals: Exports hit a record high, AI demand remains the biggest confidence for Taiwan stocks

4. Taiwan’s August exports reached US$82.4 billion, up 41% YoY, a new monthly record; cumulative exports from January to August were US$574.34 billion, up 44.2% YoY, with AI, semiconductors and ICT products still the core growth drivers. This indicates that the main issue facing Taiwan stocks is still a “funding and valuation oscillation” rather than a sudden reversal of fundamental demand. As long as demand for AI servers, ASICs, HBM, high‑speed networking and advanced process technology continues, profitability growth for Taiwan’s electronic supply chain remains supported. Thus, this pullback actually offers the market an opportunity to re‑examine corporate fundamentals; the key is not how much the index falls, but which companies can keep earning.
5. Fed and oil: Short‑term variables, but not necessarily a mid‑term bearish trend

6. The Fed will hold its FOMC meeting on September 15‑16 in the U.S. East; markets remain highly divided on whether rates will rise. Recent inflation and oil prices do increase policy risk, but Reuters’ latest survey shows most economists expect rates to stay unchanged for September and the rest of the year, so the “rate‑hike certainty” thesis still needs to be reserved. If the meeting outcome is below the most pessimistic market expectation, it could trigger a “bad‑news landing, capital outflow” scenario; conversely, if the policy signal is more hawkish, Taiwan stocks may still experience high volatility. Oil breaking $100 is another important risk, but U.S. manufacturing and services are still expanding, and corporate earnings are the core support for mid‑term global equity trends.
7. AI focus: From advanced process to CPO and high‑speed interconnect

8. SEMICON Taiwan 2026 released a clear industry signal: AI/HPC demand is driving chips from pure “process miniaturization” to “advanced packaging + high‑speed interconnect + system integration.” The official forum lists CPO, 3D‑IC, chiplet, HBM, cooling and testing as key technologies for the next AI phase. CPO’s core value lies in addressing bandwidth, power and latency bottlenecks after GPU and ASIC performance improvements, so the optical communication, optical engine, active alignment, optical metrology, probe card and final test supply chains are worth watching. Investment focus can expand from traditional AI servers to “CPO + silicon photonics + high‑speed transmission + advanced packaging testing,” seeking the next industry growth curve.
9. TSMC (2330‑TW) expansion: Advanced process and equipment remain the long‑term focus

10. TSMC continues to expand 2‑nm, 3‑nm and advanced packaging capacity. Latest supply‑chain information suggests that by mid‑2027, 2‑nm monthly capacity could rise from about 90,000 chips this year to 110,000, and 3‑nm from over 180,000 to 210,000. These figures are currently supply‑chain rumors; TSMC has not officially confirmed them. Public industry data shows that AI demand is driving continuous expansion of advanced process and packaging; the company expects 2‑nm capacity to grow at about 70% CAGR from 2026‑2028, and CoWoS and SoIC to maintain rapid expansion. Thus, the long‑term focus remains on semiconductor equipment, consumables, advanced packaging, PCB, cooling, memory, CPO, power semiconductors and PMIC—groups with real demand support.
11. Investment strategy: Market oscillation is not pessimistic, stock selection matters more than market selection

12. The most important current strategy is not to chase prices, but to “buy on pullbacks, weed out the weak and keep the strong.” High‑valuation stocks with large short‑term gains should be avoided; instead, look for AI beneficiaries whose fundamentals have not been destroyed and whose prices have fully corrected during market panic. Stock‑selection priority should be: 1) real AI orders, 2) continuous revenue growth, 3) high earnings visibility, 4) clear industry trend, 5) reasonable valuation. In summary, the biggest risk for Taiwan stocks remains the Fed, oil and international capital, while the biggest advantage is AI demand, Taiwan exports and semiconductor competitiveness. As long as the seasonal line does not break effectively and fundamentals do not reverse, this oscillation is better viewed as a “re‑shuffling of chips” rather than a signal to retreat entirely.

items.title: 瑞薩再喊漲！德微亮燈、強茂爆量大漲，功率半導體漲價潮真的來了？
items.title_en: Rohm Calls for Another Price Hike! DEWEN Hits Limit Up, Strong-Mao Surges on Volume—Is the Power Semiconductor Price‑Increase Wave Really Here?
paras: 2026年09月14日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ 台股今日下跌322點、失守月線，功率半導體族群卻逆勢走強。德微(3675-TWO)盤中攻上284.5元漲停，強茂(2481-TW)一度大漲逾9%、最高來到164元，成交量突破5萬張；台半、茂矽、富鼎及大中也同步走高，成為弱勢盤面的資金焦點。
本波漲勢的直接催化劑，來自日本功率半導體大廠瑞薩電子再度宣布調整產品價格，新價格將自2027年1月1日起生效。瑞薩表示，原材料、能源、先進封裝、製造產能及全球物流成本持續上升，是此次調價的主要原因。
值得注意的是，這並非單一廠商漲價。今年以來，英飛凌已兩度調整價格，德州儀器7月也啟動2025年以來的第四輪漲價，中國華潤微、士蘭微及宏微科技等業者陸續跟進。市場也傳出台灣強茂、台半及德微等業者，可能自10月起調漲部分現貨價格約10%至15%，但實際漲幅及產品範圍仍有待公司確認。
除了漲價題材，台廠營收也開始回溫。德微8月營收首度突破3億元，月增3.08%、年增31.51%，創下單月歷史新高；前8月累計營收20.76億元、年增20.67%，同樣改寫歷年同期新高。
(圖片來源:優分析產業數據庫)
強茂8月營收則為13.76億元，雖月減4.89%，仍年增29.81%；前8月累計營收102.01億元、年增18.1%。營收成長搭配國際大廠陸續調價，讓市場開始期待功率半導體產業是否正由庫存調整，逐步走向報價回升。
(圖片來源:優分析產業數據庫)
不過，這一輪漲價目前仍有相當部分是反映原料、能源及物流成本上升，不一定等同終端需求全面復甦。後續真正的觀察重點，是台廠能否順利將成本轉嫁給客戶、毛利率能否跟著改善，以及車用、工控與AI電源需求是否持續回升。
因此，功率半導體漲價潮確實正在擴散，但能否成為新一輪產業上升週期，不能只看價格調漲。只有當出貨量、產品價格與毛利率同步走高，才能確認這次不只是成本推動的漲價，而是真正的供需拐點。

paras_en: September 14, 2026 (Youshi Analysis/Industry Data Center reporting) – Taiwan stocks fell 322 points today, slipping below the monthly moving average, yet the power‑semiconductor sector moved higher against the trend. DEWEN (3675‑TWO) surged to the T+0 limit up at NT$284.5, and Strong‑Mao (2481‑TW) jumped more than 9% at one point, peaking at NT$164 with trading volume breaking 50,000 lots. Taiwan Semiconductor, Maoxi, Fuding and Dazhong also rose in tandem, becoming the focus of capital on the weak market.

The immediate catalyst for this rally came from Japanese power‑semiconductor giant Rohm Semiconductor, which again announced a product‑price adjustment effective January 1, 2027. Rohm said that rising raw‑material, energy, advanced‑packaging, manufacturing capacity and global logistics costs were the main reasons for the price change.

It is worth noting that this is not a single‑company price hike. Since the start of the year, Infineon has adjusted prices twice, Texas Instruments launched its fourth round of price increases in July – the first since 2025 – and Chinese players such as China Resources Micro, Silan Micro and Hongwei Technology have followed suit. The market also hears that Taiwanese firms Strong‑Mao, Taiwan Semiconductor and DEWEN may raise part of their spot‑price portfolio by roughly 10%‑15% starting in October, although the exact magnitude and product scope remain to be confirmed by the companies.

Beyond the price‑increase theme, Taiwanese manufacturers’ revenues are also warming up. DEWEN’s August revenue broke NT$300 million for the first time, up 3.08% month‑over‑month and 31.51% year‑over‑year, setting a new single‑month record; cumulative revenue for the first eight months reached NT$2.076 billion, up 20.67% year‑over‑year, also a historic high for the period.
(Image source: Youshi Analysis Industry Database)

Strong‑Mao’s August revenue was NT$1.376 billion, down 4.89% month‑over‑month but up 29.81% year‑over‑year; cumulative revenue for the first eight months was NT$10.201 billion, up 18.1% year‑over‑year. The revenue growth combined with price hikes by major international players has led the market to wonder whether the power‑semiconductor industry is moving from inventory adjustment toward a gradual price recovery.
(Image source: Youshi Analysis Industry Database)

However, much of this round of price increases still reflects higher raw‑material, energy and logistics costs and does not necessarily indicate a full recovery in end‑user demand. The key observation going forward will be whether Taiwanese firms can successfully pass the cost onto customers, improve gross margins, and whether demand from automotive, industrial control and AI power supplies continues to rebound.

Thus, the power‑semiconductor price‑increase wave is indeed spreading, but whether it will spark a new industry up‑cycle cannot be judged by price hikes alone. Only when shipment volumes, product prices and gross margins rise together can we confirm that this is not merely a cost‑driven price rise but a genuine supply‑demand turning point.

paras: 創見(2451-TW)今(14)日宣布，推出DDR5-6400 CUDIMM與CSODIMM工業用記憶體模組，提供單條64GB高容量，滿足邊緣AI、智慧製造、工業自動化及高效能嵌入式系統的運算需求。
創見表示，該產品採用DDR5雙通道架構與1.1V低工作電壓設計，搭載CKD (Client Clock Driver)時脈驅動器，可減少高速運作時因雜訊與抖動造成的訊號干擾，提升訊號穩定性；同時整合電源管理晶片(PMIC)，強化供電效率與電壓控制。SPD晶片內建溫度感測器，可即時監控記憶體溫度；搭配瞬態電壓抑制器(TVS)，可降低電壓不穩對元件造成的損害。
此外，DDR5記憶體顆粒內建On-Die ECC除錯機制，有助於提升資料完整性與長時間運作可靠性，為新一代工業運算平台提供兼具高容量、高效能與穩定性的記憶體解決方案。
創見DDR5-6400 CUDIMM與CSODIMM提供單條64GB高容量，滿足工業電腦、邊緣運算設備及嵌入式系統的高負載運算需求。模組採用DDR5雙通道架構，有效提升資料存取效率與整體傳輸效能；搭配DDR5-6400高速規格，可加速大量資料交換與即時運算，為高效能工業應用提供充足的記憶體容量與頻寬。
針對高速運作時的訊號穩定需求，模組搭載CKD時脈驅動器，可重新驅動並調整主機端傳送的時脈訊號，減少高速運作時因雜訊與抖動造成的訊號干擾，提升訊號完整性與穩定性，支援新一代高速運算平台，確保工業系統在高速、高負載、長時間運作及大量資料傳輸情境下，持續維持穩定可靠的運算效能。
在電源管理方面，此系列產品採用1.1V低工作電壓設計，有助於降低整體功耗與發熱量，適用於空間、電力及散熱條件受限的工業設備。模組亦整合電源管理晶片(PMIC)，可直接於模組端進行電源調節與分配，提升供電效率及電壓控制精準度，降低電源波動對記憶體運作的影響，進一步強化系統整體穩定性。
paras_en: Inventec (2451-TW) announced today, September 14, that it is launching DDR5‑6400 CUDIMM and CSODIMM industrial memory modules, each offering a single‑stick capacity of 64 GB to meet the computing demands of edge AI, smart manufacturing, industrial automation and high‑performance embedded systems.

Inventec says the products use a DDR5 dual‑channel architecture and a low 1.1 V operating voltage, and incorporate a CKD (Client Clock Driver) clock driver to reduce signal interference caused by noise and jitter during high‑speed operation, improving signal stability; they also integrate a power‑management IC (PMIC) to enhance power‑delivery efficiency and voltage control. An SPD chip with a built‑in temperature sensor can monitor memory temperature in real time, and a transient voltage suppressor (TVS) helps mitigate damage from voltage instability.

In addition, the DDR5 memory chips include an on‑die ECC debugging mechanism that helps improve data integrity and long‑term reliability, providing a memory solution for next‑generation industrial computing platforms that combines high capacity, high performance and stability.

The Inventec DDR5‑6400 CUDIMM and CSODIMM modules provide a single‑stick capacity of 64 GB, satisfying the high‑load computing needs of industrial PCs, edge‑computing devices and embedded systems. The modules employ a DDR5 dual‑channel architecture that effectively boosts data access efficiency and overall transfer performance; paired with the DDR5‑6400 high‑speed specification, they accelerate large data exchanges and real‑time processing, delivering ample memory capacity and bandwidth for high‑performance industrial applications.

To address signal‑stability requirements during high‑speed operation, the modules feature a CKD clock driver that re‑drives and adjusts the clock signals sent from the host, reducing noise‑ and jitter‑induced interference, enhancing signal integrity and stability, and supporting next‑generation high‑speed computing platforms. This ensures that industrial systems maintain stable and reliable performance under high‑speed, high‑load, long‑duration and massive data‑transfer scenarios.

Regarding power management, this product series uses a low 1.1 V operating voltage to help lower overall power consumption and heat generation, making it suitable for industrial equipment with limited space, power and cooling conditions. The modules also integrate a PMIC that can perform power regulation and distribution directly on the module, improving power‑delivery efficiency and voltage‑control precision, reducing the impact of power fluctuations on memory operation and further strengthening overall system stability.

面對iPhone 18 Pro系列因全球記憶體晶片成本急遽飆升、導致官方定價較前代調漲逾五千元的情勢，傑昇通信分析，在面對硬體成本轉嫁時，消費者更傾向靈活運用舊有裝置的剩餘殘值來填補價差，藉此以合理的實際支出取得新機。

距離9/18開賣僅剩四天，傑昇通信觀察，蘋果官網首批到貨的數量與去年同期大致相符，若以蘋果官網在今（14）日的實際到貨狀況來看，iPhone 18 Pro各個容量與各種顏色均已排至10/2後才能陸續到貨，規格更高的iPhone 18 Pro Max各容量與各色，則需等待長達3至4週的時間，意味著大約要到雙十連假前後才能順利拿到新機，顯見蘋果新機的買氣依舊十分熱絡，未受價格上漲影響。
隨著第四季重點銷售檔期陸續到來，傑昇通信預期在開賣後，市場上對於高性價比舊機的搶購潮，也極有可能讓iPhone 17系列面臨現貨短缺的挑戰。
paras_en: Apple (AAPL-US) unveiled its latest iPhone 18 Pro series and its first foldable, the iPhone Duo, on September 10, with sales starting on September 18 and October 23 respectively. As carriers and retailers opened reservations, Jiesheng Communications launched its own booking campaign. Based on the total orders received over the weekend, only the iPhone 18 Pro series is available for reservation this year, with pre‑order volume up 4% compared with the same period last year, and the official website’s delivery schedule already pushed out to mid‑October.

Data from Jiesheng Communications since reservations opened on September 12‑13 show that among the new models, the iPhone 18 Pro Max attracted the highest share of Apple fans, with the new Burgundy Red colour being the most popular. The iPhone 18 Pro follows, with the new Glacier Blue as the second‑most chosen hue, and both models saw the 256 GB capacity as the most demanded.

Jiesheng Communications said that even though the average price of the new iPhone 18 Pro series has jumped about 17% year‑over‑year, consumer interest remains strong, and the 4% rise in pre‑orders this year matches previous performance. Overall demand is expected to keep climbing as the fourth‑quarter holiday shopping season arrives.

Facing a sharp rise in global memory‑chip costs that pushed the official price of the iPhone 18 Pro series up by more than NT$5,000 versus the previous generation, Jiesheng Communications analysed that consumers are more likely to offset the price gap by leveraging the residual value of their old devices, thereby acquiring the new phone with a reasonable out‑of‑pocket expense.

This year, more than 40% of customers buying a new iPhone at Jiesheng’s stores used the trade‑in program, reflecting a significant increase in consumer acceptance of device‑recycling schemes and simultaneously energising the second‑hand phone market.

With only four days left until the September 18 launch, Jiesheng observed that the first batch of stock arriving on Apple’s official site is roughly on par with the same period last year. As of today (the 14th), all iPhone 18 Pro capacities and colours are scheduled to arrive after October 2, while the higher‑spec iPhone 18 Pro Max variants will take 3‑4 weeks, meaning they won’t be available until around the Double‑Ten holiday. This indicates that demand for Apple’s new phones remains robust despite the price increase.

As the key fourth‑quarter sales period approaches, Jiesheng expects that after launch, a surge in demand for high‑value‑for‑money older models could lead to a shortage of iPhone 17 inventory on the market.

items.title: 台北晶華首發！35名印尼技術人力抵台 銜接房務接待即戰力
items.title_en: Taipei Regent Hotel Launches First Wave: 35 Indonesian Technical Workers Arrive in Taiwan to Join Hospitality Operations
paras: 因應少子化及超高齡社會帶來的產業缺工挑戰，勞動部自115年1月起推動「跨國技術人力精進方案」，並開放旅宿業引進外國技術人力。首波由台北晶華酒店聘僱的35名印尼籍外國技術人力，於今（14）日搭機抵台，由勞動部勞動力發展署跨國勞動力延攬中心副主任黃偉誠及駐台北印尼經濟貿易代表處代表艾吏福（Arif Sulistiyo）親自接機。這不僅是該方案推動後首批正式入境的旅宿業外國技術人力，也象徵台灣旅宿業海外人才延攬機制正式落地。

勞動部表示，台北晶華酒店於今（115）年8月13日順利取得首批35名印尼籍外國技術人力聘僱許可。本次抵台人員過去均曾在台北晶華酒店接受技能培育及實習，具備旅宿服務經驗，並熟悉台灣的工作環境及職場文化。業者透過「跨國技術人力精進方案」延攬表現優良的外國技術人力，除可縮短來台工作人員的教育訓練期間及工作適應期，使人員抵台後更快銜接房務、訂房及旅客接待等工作外，該批人力亦具備華語或英語等優勢，長期而言將有助台灣觀光產業發展。
勞動部強調，首批旅宿業外國技術人力順利抵台是重要里程碑。該方案並非單純增加外國人力，而是將提升本國勞工勞動條件與補充產業人力相互結合。旅宿業者只要為所聘僱最低薪的全時本國基層勞工加薪至少2000元，即可按照1：1的比例取得外國技術人力聘僱名額，透過「本國勞工加薪、外國技術人力補充」的制度設計，在協助業者填補人力缺口的同時，也讓本國基層勞工共享產業發展成果。
黃偉誠補充說明，台北晶華酒店取得聘僱許可後，國內許多旅宿飯店業者亦致電表達意願。截至115年8月底止，已超過60家旅宿業者申請辦理國內求才程序，累積求才需求人數超過600人，顯示該制度已逐漸受到業者重視，反映業界對穩定人力來源的實際需求。面對旅遊市場復甦及產業人力結構改變，勞動部與交通部將共同推動外國技術人力制度，協助旅宿業穩定服務量能、健全人力配置，並提升台灣觀光住宿服務的品質與韌性。
符合資格且有外國技術人力需求的觀光旅館及一般旅館業者，可積極運用「跨國技術人力精進方案」，至公立就業服務機構辦理國內求才，並申請資格認定及聘僱許可。相關資訊可至外國人勞動權益網站「外國技術人力專區」查詢。
paras_en: In response to labor shortages caused by low birth rates and an ultra‑aged society, the Ministry of Labor has been promoting the “Cross‑Border Technical Talent Advancement Program” since January 2022 and has opened the hospitality sector to foreign technical workers. The first batch of 35 Indonesian technical personnel hired by Taipei Regent Hotel arrived in Taiwan today (the 14th) by plane, greeted by Deputy Director‑General Huang Wei‑cheng of the Ministry’s Cross‑Border Talent Recruitment Center and Arif Sulistiyo, a representative of the Indonesian Economic and Trade Office in Taipei. This marks not only the first formal entry of foreign technical workers into the hospitality industry under the program, but also the official rollout of Taiwan’s overseas talent recruitment mechanism for hotels.

The Ministry of Labor said that Taipei Regent Hotel successfully obtained employment permits for the initial 35 Indonesian technical workers on August 13, 2022. All of the arrivals have previously received skills training and internships at the hotel, possessing hospitality service experience and familiarity with Taiwan’s work environment and workplace culture. By recruiting high‑performing foreign technical talent through the “Cross‑Border Technical Talent Advancement Program,” employers can shorten the training and adaptation periods for new staff, enabling them to quickly take on duties such as housekeeping, reservations, and guest reception. Moreover, this cohort’s proficiency in Mandarin or English will, in the long run, benefit the development of Taiwan’s tourism industry.

The Ministry emphasized that the smooth arrival of the first batch of foreign technical workers in the hospitality sector is a significant milestone. The scheme is not merely about increasing foreign labor; it aims to improve domestic workers’ conditions while supplementing industry manpower. Hospitality operators who raise the minimum monthly salary of their lowest‑paid full‑time local staff by at least NT$2,000 can obtain foreign technical worker permits on a 1:1 basis. This “local wage increase + foreign technical talent” design helps fill labor gaps while allowing local grassroots workers to share in the benefits of industry growth.

Huang added that after Taipei Regent Hotel secured its hiring permit, many other domestic hotels and resorts have expressed interest. By the end of August 2022, more than 60 hospitality operators had applied for domestic recruitment procedures, with a cumulative demand for over 600 workers, indicating growing recognition of the system and a clear industry need for stable labor sources. Facing a tourism market recovery and changes in labor structure, the Ministry of Labor and the Ministry of Transportation will jointly promote the foreign technical talent framework to help hotels maintain service capacity, achieve sound staffing, and enhance the quality and resilience of Taiwan’s tourism accommodation services.

Qualified hotels and inns that need foreign technical talent are encouraged to actively use the “Cross‑Border Technical Talent Advancement Program,” apply for domestic recruitment through public employment service agencies, and seek eligibility certification and hiring permits. Relevant information can be found on the Foreign Workers’ Labor Rights website’s “Foreign Technical Talent” section.

items.title: 瑩碩思覺失調症新藥完成全球首例給藥 搶進逾百億美元長效針劑市場
items.title_en: Ying Shuo Announces First Global Administration of New Schizophrenia Drug, Targeting a $10+ Billion Long‑Acting Injection Market
paras: 瑩碩(6677-TW)今(14)日宣布，旗下經美國FDA核准臨床一期試驗的思覺失調症新藥AX251已完成全球首例病患給藥，正式啟動國際人體臨床一期試驗，也象徵自主研發的「奈米晶針劑平台(NanoCIP)」技術邁向臨床驗證，未來可望搶攻思覺失調症長效針劑逾百億美元商機。
瑩碩說明，此試驗為多中心、開放性、劑量遞增暨劑量延伸設計的臨床一期試驗，將評估思覺失調患者單次注射AX251後的藥物動力學、安全性與耐受性。
根據Grand View Research預估，至2030年全球思覺失調症藥物市場規模將達112億美元，AX251即是瞄準這塊大餅。
瑩碩進一步點出，AX251所採用的化學小分子成分，目前全球僅有口服劑型上市，其原廠口服藥全球年銷售額達45.71億美元，儘管已有國際競爭者投入長效針劑開發，但公司的全球專利布局完整，加上獨家平台優勢及製程可放大性，具成為新一代抗精神病藥物潛力。
台灣市場方面，瑩碩則指出，台灣約有14萬名思覺失調症的剛性需求，政府也編列新台幣31億元的獨立預算，採用非總額支付試辦，並將長效針劑列為優先治療選項，可望直攻在地市場的政策紅利。
瑩碩8月營收9185.8萬元，月減7.79%，年增46.36%；累計今年前8月營收6.42億元，年增17.68%。
paras_en: Ying Shuo (6677‑TW) announced today, the 14th, that its schizophrenia drug AX251, which has received FDA approval for a Phase I clinical trial, has completed the world’s first patient dosing, officially launching the international Phase I human trial and marking the NanoCIP (Nano Crystal Injection Platform) technology—developed in‑house—on its way to clinical validation, with the prospect of capturing a multi‑billion‑dollar long‑acting injection market for schizophrenia.

The company explained that the trial is a multi‑center, open‑label, dose‑escalation and dose‑extension Phase I study that will evaluate the pharmacokinetics, safety and tolerability of a single AX251 injection in patients with schizophrenia.
According to Grand View Research, the global schizophrenia drug market is projected to reach US$11.2 billion by 2030, and AX251 is aimed directly at this sizable opportunity.

Ying Shuo further noted that the small‑molecule active ingredient in AX251 is currently available worldwide only in an oral formulation, whose original manufacturer records annual global sales of US$4.571 billion. Although international competitors are already developing long‑acting injectables, the company’s comprehensive global patent portfolio, exclusive platform advantage and scalable manufacturing process give it strong potential as a next‑generation antipsychotic.

Regarding the Taiwan market, Ying Shuo pointed out that roughly 140,000 patients in Taiwan have a rigid need for schizophrenia treatment. The government has allocated a separate NT$3.1 billion budget, piloting a non‑capitation payment model and prioritizing long‑acting injectables as a preferred therapy, which could unlock local policy incentives.

Ying Shuo reported August revenue of NT$91.858 million, down 7.79% month‑over‑month but up 46.36% year‑over‑year; cumulative revenue for the first eight months of the year reached NT$642 million, a 17.68% increase year‑over‑year.

items.title: AI行業「撒謊」太久？Anthropic CEO談放緩AI研發：AI風險是真的、但無需「把一切都關掉」
items.title_en: Has the AI Industry Been "Lying" About Risks for Too Long? Anthropic CEO on Slowing AI Development: AI Risks Are Real, but No Need to "Turn Everything Off"
paras: 在全球人工智慧（AI）三大巨頭罕見聯手呼籲「放緩AI研發」的同一個週末，Anthropic執行長Dario Amodei近日接受《CBS》節目《Sunday Morning》專訪，談及AI快速發展可能帶來的風險。他表示，目前已有人嘗試利用AI研發生物武器、提升病毒傳播能力，這類威脅已成為他每天都必須面對的問題。
Amodei指出，Anthropic日前發布的一份威脅情報報告，便涉及有人濫用AI模型進行生物武器研發。
他坦言，自己當然不希望Anthropic的模型被用於造成傷害，因此公司在生物學相關能力上採取非常嚴格的安全防護措施。
他甚至提到，Anthropic的生物安全限制嚴格到經常遭到社群嘲諷，部分生物學學生也抱怨模型「沒辦法使用」。
不過，Amodei強調，與其因為安全措施受到嘲笑，他更不願看到有人利用Claude造成大規模傷亡。
週末，Amodei發表的一篇部落格文章《我們必須為尖端AI踩剎車》（We Must Pace the Frontier）引發軒然大波，並隨即獲得馬斯克、OpenAI執行長Sam Altman相繼公開支持。

AI發展進入「變陡」階段 Amodei：這是警告訊號

主持人Jo Ling Kent在訪談中直接問Amodei，AI是否真的可能在不久的將來導致人類滅亡。Amodei並未認為眼下需要陷入恐慌，但他認為目前確實出現值得重視的警訊。
他以指數成長曲線形容AI技術發展，從1、2、4、8、16、32一路上升，目前已進入曲線開始快速變陡的階段。Amodei坦言，即使自己長期提醒外界AI進步速度可能非常快，真正面對如此快速的進展時，仍比預期更加震撼。
因此，他主張AI產業應該適度放慢尖端模型的發展速度，但這並不代表要關閉AI產業或停止技術研發。
Amodei認為，真正需要確保的是，AI的安全防護、理解能力與控制能力必須跟得上技術進步。如果模型能力持續快速提升，但人類對風險的理解及控制手段沒有同步進步，便可能形成問題。

Amodei提三步方案 第三方評估員成關鍵

針對如何降低AI風險，Amodei進一步說明他提出的三階段方案，其中最重要的一步，是引入嵌入式第三方評估機制。
他主張，可以由第三方非營利組織，甚至未來由政府機構派遣評估人員，觀察AI模型從訓練到運作的完整流程。他將這類人員比喻為食品安全檢查員，但也承認，AI技術進步速度如此之快，第三方評估機制本身也必須考量能否跟上。
Amodei認為，評估員能夠跟上的速度，本身就可能成為決定AI技術推進速度的因素之一。
第二步則是由多家AI業者共同建立安全標準，包括模型發布及技術推進的安全標準。不過，他認為若要真正落實，政府也必須參與其中。
第三步則是政府正式進入這場對話。Amodei表示，當討論涉及AI產品應以多快速度發布、這樣的速度是否安全時，政府必須在場。

「AI終止開關」未必有效 Amodei主張多層防線

對於國會議員Ted Leo提出的「AI終止開關」法案，Amodei表示自己尚未詳細研究法案內容，但對「終止開關」概念本身抱持保留態度。
他認為，能夠限制、停用或關閉AI模型固然是一種手段，卻不能被視為唯一解方。若AI模型強大到一定程度，甚至可能具備規避人類關閉嘗試的能力，而Anthropic在模擬環境中也曾觀察到類似情況。
Amodei因此以「瑞士起司模型」說明他的安全理念：單一安全措施就像一片存在漏洞的瑞士起司，無法完全阻擋風險；但若建立多層防線，各層漏洞位置不同，風險便較難穿透整個體系。
他強調，沒有任何單一措施能夠完全防範AI風險，因此必須在整個AI開發與部署鏈條上維持警戒。
至於參議員Bernie Sanders與眾議員Greg Casar提出、主張「禁止超級人工智慧法案」，Amodei則明確反對全面禁止AI的方向。
他認為，若完全禁止這類技術，人類也將無法獲得AI可能帶來的重大好處，包括醫療領域的突破，這是他無法接受的結果。

父親死於丙肝、本人曾罹癌 Amodei談AI帶來的另一面

談到AI可能影響人類未來的風險與責任時，Amodei也罕見分享自己的家庭與健康經歷。
他表示，自己的父親因丙型肝炎去世時，這種疾病的治癒率約為40%，父親並未成為成功治癒的患者；但就在父親過世幾年後，一種新藥問世，將治癒率提高至約95%。
Amodei也透露，自己曾罹患早期癌症。如果生活在1950年，他可能已經因此死亡。
正因如此，他深刻體會到推動AI發展、讓科技帶來醫療等領域突破的重要性，但另一方面，也同樣感受到技術失控可能造成的風險。
他強調，這不應該成為自己或Anthropic單獨承擔的責任，而是涉及整個社會。他希望能找到一套機制，讓所有人都能參與相關討論，而不是讓一般民眾感到幾家科技公司可以自行決定AI未來。

回應前員工批評 Amodei：我們面對的是同一個結構性問題

對於前Anthropic員工Jacob Coxin公開批評Anthropic與OpenAI沒有負責任地行事、甚至是在拿人類生命冒險，Amodei則認為，外界引用相關言論時忽略了其中另一個部分。
他表示，Coxin同時認為Anthropic是主要AI業者中較為負責任的一家，而他所指出的核心問題，其實與Amodei目前提出的警告相同，也就是所有AI公司共同面臨的結構性困境。
Amodei表示，他提出的三階段方案正是希望處理這種結構性問題。
他並透露，Anthropic每天都與美國商務部、財政部及情報界官員溝通，並向政府部門分享公司掌握的資訊。

Amodei：AI產業對風險「說謊太久」

對於一般正在使用Claude、ChatGPT等AI工具的民眾，Amodei表示，AI本身仍是一項具有大量正面用途的重大技術，目前每週都有數億人利用相關技術完成各種事情，他也經常收到使用者來信，表示Claude協助發現醫師未能診斷出的疾病。
不過，他強調自己不會對使用者隱瞞AI存在的風險。
Amodei認為，AI產業過去太長時間都以非常正面的方式呈現這項技術，對相關風險避重就輕。他主張，面對AI快速發展，第一步就是必須誠實告訴大眾風險確實存在。
他最後表示，AI是人類歷史上最重要的技術事件之一，因此不能只由少數科技公司決定其發展方向，而應該讓所有人參與其中。
paras_en: On the same weekend that the three global AI giants unusually joined forces to call for a "slow‑down of AI research," Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei recently appeared on CBS's "Sunday Morning" to discuss the risks of rapid AI development. He said that people are already trying to use AI to develop bioweapons and enhance virus transmissibility, threats he now faces every day.
Amodei noted that Anthropic recently released a threat‑intelligence report that documented misuse of AI models for bioweapon research.
He admitted that, of course, he does not want Anthropic's models used to cause harm, so the company has implemented extremely strict safety safeguards around any biology‑related capabilities.
He even mentioned that Anthropic's bio‑security restrictions are so strict they are often mocked by the community, and some biology students complain the model "doesn't work for them."
Nevertheless, Amodei stressed that rather than being laughed at for safety measures, he would rather not see anyone use Claude to cause mass casualties.
Over the weekend, Amodei's blog post "We Must Pace the Frontier" sparked a firestorm and quickly earned public support from Elon Musk and OpenAI CEO Sam Altman.

AI development has entered a "steepening" phase, Amodei says: This is a warning signal. Host Jo Ling Kent asked directly whether AI could realistically cause human extinction in the near future. Amodei said panic is not warranted now, but he believes there are warning signs that deserve attention.

He described AI progress as an exponential curve—1, 2, 4, 8, 16, 32—now entering a phase where the curve steepens rapidly. Amodei confessed that even though he has long warned about the speed of AI advances, the actual pace is more shocking than he expected.
Therefore, he argues the AI industry should moderately slow the development of frontier models, but this does not mean shutting down the industry or halting research altogether.

Amodei believes the real need is to ensure AI safety, interpretability, and control keep pace with technical progress. If model capabilities keep accelerating while human understanding of risks and control mechanisms lag, problems will arise.
Amodei outlined a three‑step plan to reduce AI risk, with third‑party evaluators being a key component.

He proposes that independent nonprofit organizations—or eventually government‑appointed assessors—monitor the entire lifecycle of AI models from training to deployment. He likens these assessors to food‑safety inspectors, while acknowledging that the rapid pace of AI may challenge the evaluators' ability to keep up.
Amodei says the speed at which evaluators can keep up could itself become a factor that determines how fast AI technology moves forward.

The second step calls for multiple AI firms to jointly establish safety standards covering model releases and technical progress, though he notes that genuine implementation will require government participation.

The third step brings the government formally into the conversation. Amodei says that when discussions involve how quickly AI products should be released and whether that speed is safe, the government must be present.
Regarding Congressman Ted Leo's proposed "AI kill‑switch" legislation, Amodei said he has not studied the bill in detail but remains skeptical of the kill‑switch concept itself.

He believes that while the ability to limit, suspend, or shut down an AI model is a tool, it cannot be the sole solution. If a model becomes powerful enough, it may develop ways to evade human shutdown attempts—a behavior Anthropic has observed in simulated environments.

Amodei uses the "Swiss cheese model" to illustrate his safety philosophy: a single safety measure is like a slice of Swiss cheese with holes that cannot fully block risk; multiple layers with differently placed holes make it much harder for risk to penetrate the whole system.
He stresses that no single measure can completely prevent AI risk, so vigilance must be maintained across the entire AI development and deployment chain.
As for Senator Bernie Sanders and Representative Greg Casar's proposed "Ban Super‑AI" legislation, Amodei is clearly opposed to an outright ban on AI.
He argues that a total prohibition would deprive humanity of AI's huge benefits, such as breakthroughs in medicine, a result he finds unacceptable.
When discussing AI's potential impact on humanity's future, Amodei also unusually shared personal family and health experiences.

He said his father died of hepatitis C, a disease that at the time had a cure rate of about 40 % and his father was not among the cured; a few years after his father's death, a new drug raised the cure rate to roughly 95 %.
Amodei also disclosed that he once had early‑stage cancer and that, had he lived in 1950, he likely would have died from it.
Because of this, he deeply appreciates the importance of advancing AI to enable medical breakthroughs, while also feeling the weight of potential risks from uncontrolled technology.

He emphasizes that this responsibility should not fall solely on him or Anthropic, but on society as a whole. He hopes to create mechanisms that let everyone participate in the discussion rather than leaving the future of AI in the hands of a few tech firms.

Responding to former Anthropic employee Jacob Coxin, who publicly criticized Anthropic and OpenAI for irresponsible behavior and risking human lives, Amodei said outsiders often miss another part of the story when quoting those remarks.

He noted that Coxin also considers Anthropic one of the more responsible AI companies, and that the core issue Coxin highlighted aligns with Amodei's own warning: a structural dilemma faced by all AI firms.
Amodei said his three‑stage proposal is intended to address this structural problem.
He also revealed that Anthropic communicates daily with officials from the U.S. Department of Commerce, Treasury and intelligence agencies, sharing the company's insights with the government.

Amodei: The AI industry has "lied" about risk for too long. For everyday users of Claude, ChatGPT and similar tools, he says AI remains a major technology with huge positive uses; hundreds of millions of people each week rely on it for a variety of tasks, and he often receives messages from users saying Claude helped detect diseases that doctors missed.
However, he stresses that he will not hide the existence of AI risks from users.

Amodei believes the AI industry has presented the technology in an overly positive light for far too long, downplaying associated risks. He argues that the first step in confronting rapid AI development is to honestly tell the public that risks truly exist.
He concludes that AI is one of the most important technological events in human history, and its direction should not be decided solely by a handful of tech companies but should involve everyone.

items.title: iPhone 18 Pro賣不動？美英德日等待時間縮短 中港反而拉長
paras: 蘋果(AAPL-US) iPhone 18 Pro 系列預售浮現警訊。傑富瑞（Jefferies）追蹤顯示，美英德日交貨等待時間較去年縮短 5 至 11 天，美國 iPhone 18 Pro 甚至無需等待，顯示需求可能轉弱。
中國與香港則逆勢升溫，但傑富瑞認為，投機性搶購可能干擾實際需求，仍待首批新機出貨後進一步驗證。
根據傑富瑞周一(14 日)發布的報告，蘋果自12 日美東時間上午 8 時開放預購後，團隊持續追蹤美國、英國、德國、日本、中國及香港六大市場的交貨等待時間，今年並新增印度市場，但年增比較仍以原有六大市場為基準。
美英德日等待時間縮短 需求浮現警訊
截至14 日美東時間中午，iPhone 18 Pro Max 在美國、英國、德國、日本的交貨等待時間，較去年同期 iPhone 17 Pro Max 縮短約 5 至 11 天。iPhone 18 Pro 的情況也類似，美國市場目前已無需等待，其他多數海外市場的等待時間也較去年縮短約 1 至 11 天。
傑富瑞認為，在今年生產節奏與上一代基本持平的情況下，交貨週期縮短可視為需求轉弱的可靠訊號。
去年 iPhone 17 Pro Max 與 iPhone 17 Pro 的等待時間明顯長於 iPhone 16 系列，後續也證明是銷售強勁的前瞻指標，如今 iPhone 18 Pro 系列的數據出現逆轉，使分析師對後續銷售前景轉趨審慎。
印度市場方面，iPhone 18 Pro 目前等待時間僅約 2 至 3 天，iPhone 18 Pro Max 約 12 天，兩款機型交貨週期都明顯短於中國市場，目前仍難以將此解讀為需求強勁。
中港逆勢升溫 真實需求仍待觀察
中國與香港成為這波預售追蹤中的例外。數據顯示，iPhone 18 Pro Max 在中國與香港的等待時間均達 24.5 天，高於去年同期的 19.8 天與 17.2 天，分別較去年延長約 4 天及 7 天，與其他主要市場等待時間縮短形成鮮明對比。
不過，傑富瑞對中港市場的強勁數據仍持保留態度。報告指出，兩地過去新款 iPhone 上市初期都有較活躍的投機性搶購行為，因此等待時間拉長，部分可能來自通路囤貨，而非終端消費者的真實需求。
分析師認為，18 日首批新機開始出貨後，二手市場的轉售價格將成為判斷實際需求的重要指標。如果轉售溢價快速縮小，甚至跌破發行價，可能意味著初期投機需求釋放後迅速消退。
Duo軟體體驗獲肯定 硬體規格面臨考驗
除了 iPhone 18 Pro 系列預售表現，傑富瑞也關注蘋果折疊螢幕新機 Duo。
Duo 預計 10 月 16 日開放預購，目前網路流出的初步評測整體偏正面，但好評主要集中在軟體體驗，包括 iOS 對折疊螢幕的適配、內外螢幕切換流暢度、原生分割畫面邏輯、應用程式連續性，以及雙應用多工處理等。
相較之下，Duo 的硬體規格則面臨較多質疑。批評意見包括浮動視窗數量有限，多工處理同時最多只能運行兩個應用程式，而三星 Galaxy Z Fold 8 可支援三個，Duo 同時也缺乏類 PC 功能。
傑富瑞整理的規格比較顯示，Duo 起售價為 1,999 美元，重量 254 克，摺疊狀態厚度 11.3 毫米；相較之下，三星 Galaxy Z Fold 8 重量 201 克、摺疊厚度 9.7 毫米，起售價 1,899 美元。
這也意味著，Duo 在價格更高的情況下，機身重量與厚度並未占優勢。
相機同樣是市場關注焦點。Duo 配備 4,800 萬畫素主鏡頭與 4,800 萬畫素超廣角鏡頭，沒有專屬長焦鏡頭；部分安卓折疊螢幕旗艦則已提供三鏡頭系統與光學變焦功能。處理器方面，Duo 採用蘋果自研 A20 Pro，使用 2 奈米製程。
逾2000美元價位 硬體差距更受關注
傑富瑞分析師指出，蘋果過去並非單純依靠硬體規格取得市場份額，軟硬體整合與使用體驗一直是其產品競爭力之一。
然而，在接近 2,000 美元的高價位帶，硬體規格可能成為既有 iPhone 用戶是否願意升級至 Duo 的重要考量，也可能增加蘋果說服高階安卓折疊螢幕手機用戶轉換陣營的難度。
因此，儘管 Duo 初步軟體體驗獲得正面評價，傑富瑞對這款折疊螢幕新機的整體判斷自發布以來並未改變。
