在 iPhone 18 Pro 預售等待時間縮短、中港市場需求仍待驗證，以及 Duo 高價策略面臨硬體規格競爭等因素下，傑富瑞維持蘋果股票「跑輸大盤」（Underperform）評級，12 個月目標價為 263.66 美元。相較目前股價 332.27 美元，目標價隱含約 21% 下跌空間。
該目標價以截至 2031 財年的現金流折現模型估算，加權平均資本成本為 7.8%，永續成長率為 4.3%，並相當於蘋果 2026 財年預估本益比約 30 倍。

items.title: 高盛：AI資本支出貢獻標普500半數獲利成長 集中度風險加劇
items.title_en: Goldman Sachs: AI Capital Spending Drives About Half of S&P 500 Earnings Growth, Raising Concentration Risk
paras: 高盛美國股票首席策略師Ben Snider於 CNBC 節目中指出，人工智慧(AI)投資支出正推動標普500指數約一半的盈餘成長。
Snider提醒，這項數據意味著整體大盤的獲利增長，高度依賴少數超大型雲端業者(Hyperscalers)所主導的資本支出周期，若買家縮減支出，盈餘成長恐將迅速放緩。
這波支出周期由輝達(NVDA-US)、博通(AVGO-US)與微軟(MSFT-US)等巨頭核心驅動。輝達第二季營收達962.2億美元(年增105.8%)，資料中心業務佔890.2億美元；博通第三季AI晶片營收年增221%至167億美元；微軟全年資本支出則達1,159.5億美元，下一年度預計增加至約1,750億美元。
Snider補充，企業AI支出正從基礎設施拓展至應用端，如微軟 365 Copilot 付費席位已突破3,000萬個。
Snider表示，年初標普500指數的本益比為22倍，目前為19倍，接近歷史高點。獲利成長速度超過股價，因此在股價持續上漲的同時，本益比也隨之下降。
儘管美國10年期公債殖利率升至4.83% 高位，但他認為波動度影響大於殖利率，強勁的盈餘背景仍能支撐大盤。
Snider表示，高盛的部位指標(指標綜合考慮了對沖基金、共同基金和其他投資者的部位)已降至3月以來最低，即便市場接近高點。部位較低可以緩衝拋售，因為持倉較少意味著需要平倉的部位也較少。
他指出，9月的季節性因素通常較弱，尤其是在期中選舉年，VIX指數已升至16.46。下一次CPI數據公布以及聯準會的動向值得密切關注，其目標利率為3.75%。
paras_en: Goldman Sachs U.S. equity chief strategist Ben Snider told CNBC that artificial‑intelligence (AI) investment spending is driving roughly half of the earnings growth in the S&P 500 index.

Snider warned that this figure means overall market profit growth is heavily dependent on a capital‑spending cycle led by a few ultra‑large cloud providers (hyperscalers); if buyers cut back, earnings growth could slow sharply.

The spending cycle is being driven by giants such as Nvidia (NVDA-US), Broadcom (AVGO-US) and Microsoft (MSFT-US). Nvidia posted Q2 revenue of $96.22 billion, up 105.8% YoY, with its data‑center business accounting for $89.02 billion; Broadcom’s AI‑chip revenue in Q3 jumped 221% YoY to $16.7 billion; Microsoft’s full‑year capital expenditure reached $115.95 billion and is expected to rise to about $175 billion next year.
Snider added that corporate AI spending is expanding from infrastructure to the application layer, noting that paid seats for Microsoft 365 Copilot have already surpassed 30 million.

Snider said the S&P 500’s price‑to‑earnings multiple was 22× at the start of the year and is now about 19×, near historic highs. Earnings are growing faster than the stock price, so the multiple is falling even as prices keep climbing.
Even though the U.S. 10‑year Treasury yield has climbed to a high of 4.83%, he believes volatility matters more than the yield level and that a strong earnings backdrop can still support the market.

Snider noted that Goldman’s positioning indicator—which aggregates positions of hedge funds, mutual funds and other investors—has fallen to its lowest level since March, even as the market nears a peak. Lower positioning provides a buffer against selling because fewer holdings need to be liquidated.

He pointed out that September’s seasonal factors are usually weak, especially in a mid‑term election year, with the VIX now at 16.46. The next CPI release and the Fed’s actions, targeting a 3.75% policy rate, deserve close attention.

items.title: 美股漲勢卡關 高盛揭三重阻力、點名四大投資機會
items.title_en: U.S. Stocks Stall as Goldman Sachs Identifies Three Layers of Resistance and Highlights Four Major Investment Opportunities
paras: 美股第二季強勢上攻後陷入橫盤，高盛合夥人 Mark Wilson 指出，中期選舉歷史規律、量化資金仍接近滿倉做多，以及能源、債券與股票之間的連鎖壓力，正形成美股三重阻力。不過，他認為市場並非沒有機會，AI 基礎設施、大宗商品及相關股票、德國股市與大型銀行，仍是值得關注的四大布局方向。
美股第二季走出強勁行情，那斯達克指數單季大漲 32%，費城半導體指數更飆升 87%，但此後市場轉入橫盤，漲勢明顯停頓。Wilson 在最新一期《Weekly Mash》中分析，目前市場面臨的壓力，已從單純的估值問題轉向多項因素交互作用。
中期選舉、量化資金形成壓力
第一重阻力來自美國中期選舉。Wilson 引用 1974 年以來歷史數據指出，從每年 8 月初至中期選舉期間，美股中位數報酬率為 0%。他坦言，沒有人能確定這項歷史規律究竟具有多大效力，但由於這項數據被市場頻繁引用，投資人實際上已開始依循這項規律進行交易。
第二重阻力則來自量化資金。對沖基金在夏季已完成降倉，整體曝險降至過去一年中等水準，選股型基金部位甚至更低。不過，Wilson 認為，這對大盤指數影響有限，因為對沖基金降低風險時，通常會同時削減贏家與輸家部位。
真正值得留意的是，趨勢追蹤基金與波動率目標策略目前仍接近滿倉做多。Wilson 指出，這類資金不會主動進行避險，一旦市場價格下跌，反而可能觸發賣出，使跌勢進一步承壓。
能源、債券、股票形成「三角絞殺」
第三重阻力，也是 Wilson 認為最棘手的問題，是能源、債券與股票之間形成的連鎖效應。
他的邏輯是，地緣政治局勢推升油氣價格，能源價格上漲進一步推高債券殖利率，而殖利率攀升最終壓縮股票估值。Wilson 將此形容為當前市場內在關聯最緊密的核心矛盾，也是「最難解的問題」，尤其殖利率已經走高相當長一段時間。
近期川普表示，伊朗問題可能延續至中期選舉之後，目前阿曼與海灣國家將和伊朗就荷姆茲海峽通行問題展開會談，高盛也再度上調油氣價格預測。
天然氣市場同樣存在壓力。Wilson 指出，迫使亞洲降低消費、進而為歐洲釋放供應所需的價格水準已大致達到，天然氣價格也已突破 3 月高點，但歐洲仍可能以歷史低檔的庫存水準進入冬季。
Wilson 認為，前兩項阻力可能隨時間推移或市場價格回檔逐漸消化，但能源與殖利率之間的難題不會隨中期選舉結束而消失。
AI基建估值逐漸浮現吸引力
儘管美股面臨三重阻力，Wilson 仍提出四大布局方向，首先就是 AI 基礎設施。
他認為，AI 基本面仍持續走強，關鍵並非通用人工智慧（AGI）敘事，而是科技巨頭持續擴張的資本支出。包括甲骨文(ORCL-US) 最新財報、微軟(MSFT-US) 宣布未來 6 年將資料中心容量擴大 3 倍，以及輝達(NVDA-US) 再度上調市場規模預期，都顯示大型科技公司的投資仍在更大的基礎上加速。
在估值方面，輝達目前以 2028 年獲利計算的本益比約為 10.3 倍。Wilson 認為，較理想的進場條件，是債券殖利率停止攀升，加上市場開始將目光轉向 2028 年，屆時相關龍頭股可能重新啟動。
看好金屬、德國股市
第二個方向是大宗商品。Wilson 指出，在高名目成長、財政前景惡化、貨幣貶值疑慮，以及大宗商品帶動通膨壓力的環境下，市場對大宗商品及相關股票的關注程度反而不足。
相較能源類股，他對金屬板塊更具信心，尤其點名銅。Wilson 認為，在成長型資本支出不足、供給稀缺性日益明顯的情況下，銅相關股票的估值仍未充分重估。
第三個方向則是德國股市。Wilson 認為，市場對德國經濟存在刻板印象，但汽車與化工產業在德國股市占比分別僅 5%與 7%，德國本土業務也只占 DAX 指數成分股銷售額約 20%。
另一方面，德國正推動大規模財政刺激，高盛預估，2027 年德國企業獲利將成長 17%，DAX 指數結構也逐漸轉向國防、電氣化、AI 與科技，目前本益比約 15 倍。Wilson 並指出，退休金改革可能使原本賣出德國股票的本國儲蓄者轉為買方，成為市場潛在催化劑。
大型銀行迎來新成長動能
第四個布局方向是大型銀行。Wilson 引述高盛 Richard Ramsden 的研究指出，美國銀行業資本市場手續費收入在 2010 年至 2019 年間平均每年下降約 1%，但 2019 年至 2026 年則以每年 11%的速度複合成長；即使排除 AI 相關業務高峰影響，仍可維持約 4%的年增速，且被認為具有持續性。
Wilson 同時指出，AI 相關融資需求可能使部分業務從精品投行重新流向具有資產負債表支撐的大型銀行，加上過去 15 年的嚴格監管環境正在退潮，都可能提供銀行股進一步支撐。
不過，他也提醒，若民主黨在 11 月選舉中橫掃，監管環境可能出現變數，而大型銀行能否持續維持高股東權益報酬率，仍是後續市場關注的核心問題。
paras_en: After a strong rally in the second quarter, U.S. equities have entered a sideways phase, and Goldman Sachs partner Mark Wilson says that a combination of midterm election historical patterns, quantitative funds still near full‑long exposure, and the chain pressure among energy, bonds and stocks is creating three layers of resistance for the market. Nonetheless, he believes opportunities remain, with AI infrastructure, commodities and related stocks, the German market, and large banks being the four key areas to watch.

U.S. stocks posted a robust Q2, with the Nasdaq soaring 32% for the quarter and the Philadelphia Semiconductor Index jumping 87%, but the market has since moved into a range‑bound mode, halting the upward momentum. In the latest "Weekly Mash," Wilson analyzes that the pressure on the market has shifted from a pure valuation issue to a mix of interacting factors.
Midterm elections and quantitative capital create pressure

The first layer of resistance comes from the U.S. midterm elections. Wilson cites historical data since 1974 showing that from early August through the election period, the median return of U.S. equities is zero percent. He admits that no one can be certain how strong this pattern truly is, but because the data is frequently referenced, investors have already begun to trade in line with it.

The second layer of resistance stems from quantitative capital. Hedge funds have trimmed positions over the summer, bringing overall exposure down to a mid‑range level for the past year, with stock‑picking funds even lower. Wilson, however, believes this has limited impact on the broad market index, as hedge funds typically cut both winning and losing positions when they de‑risk.

What truly warrants attention is that trend‑following funds and volatility‑target strategies are still near full‑long exposure. Wilson notes that this capital does not actively hedge; if prices fall, it may trigger selling, adding further pressure to the decline.
Energy, bonds and stocks form a "triangular squeeze"
The third layer of resistance, which Wilson sees as the most tricky, is the chain effect among energy, bonds and equities.

His logic is that geopolitical tensions lift oil and gas prices, which in turn push bond yields higher, and rising yields compress equity valuations. Wilson describes this as the tightest internal market contradiction and "the hardest problem to solve," especially since yields have been elevated for a considerable period.

Recently, former President Trump said the Iran issue could extend beyond the midterms, and Oman and Gulf states are set to negotiate with Iran over passage through the Hormuz Strait. Goldman Sachs has also upgraded its oil and gas price forecasts.

The natural gas market faces similar pressure. Wilson points out that the price level needed to force Asian demand cuts and free up supply for Europe has largely been reached; gas prices have already surpassed the March peak, yet Europe may still enter winter with historically low inventory levels.

Wilson believes the first two sources of resistance may gradually dissipate over time or as market prices retrace, but the dilemma between energy and yields will not disappear with the end of the midterm elections.
AI infrastructure valuations are gradually revealing appeal
Even with three layers of resistance, Wilson outlines four strategic themes, starting with AI infrastructure.

He argues that AI fundamentals remain strong, not because of the generic artificial general intelligence narrative, but due to the continued capital‑expenditure expansion by tech giants. Recent Oracle (ORCL-US) earnings, Microsoft’s (MSFT-US) plan to triple data‑center capacity over the next six years, and Nvidia’s (NVDA-US) upward revision of market size all signal accelerating investment by large technology firms.

On valuation, Nvidia currently trades at a forward P/E of about 10.3 times earnings projected for 2028. Wilson says the ideal entry point would be when bond yields stop climbing and the market shifts its focus to 2028, at which time the leading AI stocks could restart their rally.
Positive outlook on metals and the German market

The second theme is commodities. Wilson notes that in an environment of high headline growth, worsening fiscal outlooks, currency depreciation concerns, and commodity‑driven inflation pressures, market attention to commodities and related stocks is actually insufficient.

Compared with energy stocks, he has more confidence in the metals sector, especially copper. Wilson believes that with weak growth‑type capex and increasingly evident supply scarcity, copper‑related stocks have not yet been fully re‑priced.

The third theme is the German equity market. Wilson says the market holds a stereotypical view of the German economy, yet automotive and chemical industries account for only 5% and 7% of the DAX composition respectively, and domestic business makes up roughly 20% of DAX constituent sales.

Meanwhile, Germany is rolling out large‑scale fiscal stimulus; Goldman estimates German corporate earnings will grow 17% by 2027, and the DAX is gradually shifting toward defense, electrification, AI and technology, currently trading at about a 15‑times P/E. Wilson also points out that pension reforms could turn domestic savers who previously sold German stocks into buyers, acting as a potential catalyst.
Large banks gain new growth momentum

The fourth theme is large banks. Wilson cites research by Goldman’s Richard Ramsden showing that U.S. banking capital‑market fee income fell an average of 1% per year from 2010 to 2019, but is projected to compound at 11% annually from 2019 to 2026; even excluding the AI‑related peak, a roughly 4% annual growth rate remains and is considered sustainable.

Wilson adds that AI‑driven financing demand may shift some business from boutique investment banks back to large banks with strong balance sheets, and the easing of the strict regulatory environment of the past 15 years could further support bank stocks.

He cautions, however, that a Democratic sweep in the November election could introduce regulatory uncertainty, and whether large banks can maintain high return on equity will remain a core focus for the market.

items.title: 輝達愈來愈依賴大客戶 3家就貢獻44%營收
items.title_en: Nvidia’s Growing Dependence on a Few Big Customers: Three Firms Account for 44% of Revenue
paras: 輝達(NVDA-US) 營收規模急速膨脹，但客戶結構也明顯朝少數大型買家集中。根據 The Information 報導，截至今年7月的本財年上半年，輝達已有三家客戶各自貢獻超過10%總營收，三者合計占比高達44%，凸顯公司對大客戶的依賴程度持續升高。
相較之下，上一財年輝達僅有兩家客戶合計貢獻36%營收；而在2023財年，甚至沒有任何單一客戶占總營收比重超過10%。隨著AI資料中心需求爆發，輝達營收高速成長之際，客戶集中度也同步攀升。
資料中心暴增 大客戶重要性升高
客戶結構快速集中的背後，與輝達資料中心業務爆發式成長密切相關。資料中心營收從2023財年的約150億美元，大幅攀升至上一財年的1,937億美元，今年更有望再度翻倍。隨著業務規模擴張，大型客戶對輝達營收的重要性也日益提高。
輝達並未在公開文件中點名上述三家客戶，但 The Information 分析，其中可能包括戴爾(DELL-US) 或鴻海(2317-TW) ，兩家公司均採購輝達晶片，整合至伺服器後再轉售給其他企業。
戴爾近期公布，「AI優化伺服器」第二季營收年增至164億美元，帶動整體營收成長58%；鴻海上半年營收也年增35%，主要動能來自AI設備銷售。
輝達財務長Colette Kress今年2月曾表示，五大雲端廠商及「超大規模運算」客戶合計貢獻資料中心營收逾50%。
微軟(MSFT-US) 、Meta(META-US) 與SpaceX(SPCX-US) 均被視為輝達的重要買家，三家公司都在大規模建置AI資料中心。Google(GOOGL-US)與亞馬遜(AMZN-US) 同樣大量採購輝達晶片，但由於兩家公司也大量使用自研AI晶片，因此較不可能躋身輝達最大客戶之列。
大客戶自研晶片 埋下需求隱憂
客戶集中度升高之際，另一項潛在風險是主要客戶正積極發展自研晶片。微軟、Meta及SpaceX均推動自研AI晶片計畫，一旦相關晶片逐漸成熟，未來對輝達產品的採購需求可能隨之下降。
這也解釋了為何輝達執行長黃仁勳近年持續投資新興雲端服務商（neocloud）與AI企業，包括CoreWeave(CRWV-US) 、Nebius(NBIS-US) 等。這些公司既是輝達投資對象，也是其晶片的重要買家。
因精準預判2008年次貸危機而聞名的投資人Michael Burry，近幾個月也公開將輝達客戶集中度上升列為重大風險之一。
應收帳款也高度集中
客戶集中的情況也反映在應收帳款。輝達今年7月揭露，五家客戶占公司應收帳款餘額70%，高於今年1月三家客戶占56%；而在2025財年末，則是兩家客戶占33%，顯示應收帳款同樣快速向少數大型客戶集中。
與此同時，輝達上半年應收帳款餘額大增64%至630億美元，主因公司針對部分投資級大客戶的大型、跨季度協議延長付款期限。
目前付款期限已從上一季的45天拉長至60天，公司並表示，部分投資級客戶未來可能獲得90天至最長一年的付款期限，以協助完成大型資料中心建設。
付款期限拉長，意味著輝達單季實際收到的現金減少，同時也讓公司的財務狀況與大型客戶的信用狀況更加緊密地綁在一起。
向海外與新興客戶擴張
面對客戶集中度升高的壓力，輝達也持續向海外及新興市場擴張。本週公司將多家澳洲企業納入「AI工廠」（AI Factory）計畫，向建造及營運資料中心的企業提供晶片與網路設備；今年稍早，輝達也在印度和亞美尼亞推動類似計畫。
這一系列布局，是輝達在美國大型買家之外，積極培養主權客戶及新興雲端服務商的一環，藉此進一步擴大客戶基礎。
paras_en: Nvidia (NVDA-US) has seen its revenue scale explode, but its customer base is increasingly concentrated among a few large buyers. According to a report by The Information, in the first half of the fiscal year ending July this year, three Nvidia customers each contributed more than 10% of total revenue, together accounting for as much as 44%, highlighting the company’s rising reliance on big customers.

By contrast, in the previous fiscal year Nvidia had only two customers that together contributed 36% of revenue; and in fiscal 2023 no single customer accounted for more than 10% of total revenue. As AI data‑center demand surged, Nvidia’s rapid revenue growth was matched by a rise in customer concentration.
Data‑center boom raises the importance of big customers

The rapid concentration of Nvidia’s customer base is closely tied to the explosive growth of its data‑center business. Data‑center revenue jumped from roughly $15 billion in fiscal 2023 to $193.7 billion in the most recent fiscal year, and is expected to double again this year. As the business scales, large customers become increasingly critical to Nvidia’s top line.

Nvidia did not name the three customers in public filings, but The Information speculates they may include Dell (DELL-US) or Foxconn (2317‑TW), both of which purchase Nvidia chips and integrate them into servers for resale to other enterprises.

Dell recently reported that its “AI‑optimized server” segment generated $16.4 billion in Q2 revenue, driving overall revenue growth of 58%; Foxconn’s first‑half revenue also rose 35% year‑over‑year, mainly powered by AI‑equipment sales.
Nvidia’s CFO Colette Kress said in February that the five major cloud providers and “hyperscale” customers together contributed more than 50% of data‑center revenue.

Microsoft (MSFT-US), Meta (META‑US) and SpaceX (SPCX‑US) are all viewed as key Nvidia buyers, each building AI data centers at massive scale. Google (GOOGL‑US) and Amazon (AMZN‑US) also buy large volumes of Nvidia chips, but because they heavily use their own AI silicon, they are less likely to rank among Nvidia’s top customers.
Big customers develop their own chips, creating demand uncertainty

As customer concentration rises, a potential risk is that major buyers are actively developing their own AI chips. Microsoft, Meta and SpaceX are all pursuing in‑house AI chip projects, and as those chips mature, their demand for Nvidia products could decline.

This also explains why Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang has recently continued to invest in emerging cloud providers (neocloud) and AI firms such as CoreWeave (CRWV‑US) and Nebius (NBIS‑US). These companies are both investment targets and important buyers of Nvidia chips.
Investor Michael Burry, famed for predicting the 2008 sub‑prime crisis, has publicly listed the rising Nvidia customer concentration as a major risk in recent months.
Accounts receivable also highly concentrated

The concentration of customers is reflected in accounts receivable as well. Nvidia disclosed in July that five customers accounted for 70% of its receivable balance, up from three customers representing 56% in January; by the end of fiscal 2025, two customers will represent 33%, showing receivables are also rapidly concentrating among a few large clients.

At the same time, Nvidia’s receivable balance surged 64% in the first half of the year to $63 billion, mainly because the company extended payment terms for large, multi‑quarter agreements with certain investment‑grade customers.

Payment terms have now been stretched from 45 days last quarter to 60 days, and Nvidia said some investment‑grade customers may later receive terms of 90 days up to a full year to help fund large data‑center builds.
Longer payment terms mean Nvidia receives less cash in a given quarter, tying its financial health more closely to the creditworthiness of its biggest customers.
Expanding overseas and to emerging customers

Facing pressure from higher customer concentration, Nvidia is also expanding overseas and into emerging markets. This week the company added several Australian firms to its “AI Factory” program, supplying chips and networking gear to companies that build and operate data centers; earlier this year Nvidia launched similar initiatives in India and Armenia.
These moves are part of Nvidia’s effort, beyond the major U.S. buyers, to cultivate sovereign customers and emerging cloud providers, further broadening its customer base.

items.title: 控速不停止！奧特曼：全球需要相信美國AI企業將負責行事 歡迎建立統一安全要求框架
items.title_en: Don't Stop Slowing Down! Altman: The World Must Trust US AI Companies to Act Responsibly, Welcomes a Unified Safety Requirements Framework
paras: OpenAI執行長奧特曼最新表示，支持對AI研發「控制節奏」的想法，以確保最先進模型的能力增長不會快到超出人類維持控制的能力。
奧特曼呼應了Anthropic執行長Dario Amodei近期表態。他周日(13日)在X平台上發文表示，將更多資源和研發重心轉向安全雖會帶來代價，但為了維持外界對美國企業正負責任地開發日益強大的AI的信心，這樣做是值得的。
奧特曼在文中寫道：「無論美國面臨多大的競爭壓力，都不應成為魯莽行事的藉口，也不應讓能力發展超越安全對齊和監測機制。」
他同時強調，確保安全並不意味著停止技術進步。「當我們談論『控制節奏』時，並不是在談論『停止發展』。」
週一，亞洲AI相關股票普遍下跌。OpenAI重要投資人軟銀在東京股市重挫13%，南韓三星電子和SK海力士在首爾市場跌幅均超過4%。
奧特曼在周日推文中也重申OpenAI支持建立聯邦層面的AI監管框架。在外界普遍擔心美國AI企業即使主動放慢研發節奏。
他寫道，「OpenAI歡迎一套聯邦監管框架，為先進AI設立統一的安全要求。不過，企業無需等待反壟斷豁免或相關立法落地，才開始建立這種信任」，並指出制定統一規則管控前線風險，例如引進獨立審計機構，是實現收益最大化的良策。
奧特曼還表示，轉向聚焦安全的AI開發與評估，需要新的工具。OpenAI期待與其他產業參與者合作，制定關於模型對齊偏差、監控及安全性的標準。
paras_en: OpenAI CEO Sam Altman recently said he supports the idea of "controlling the pace" of AI research to ensure that the capabilities of the most advanced models do not grow faster than humanity’s ability to keep them under control.

Altman echoed recent remarks by Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei. On Sunday the 13th he posted on X that shifting more resources and R&D focus toward safety will come at a cost, but it is worth it to maintain confidence that US firms are responsibly developing ever‑more powerful AI.

Altman wrote in the post: "No matter how intense the competitive pressure on the United States, it should never be an excuse for reckless action, nor should it allow capability development to outpace safety alignment and monitoring mechanisms."
He also stressed that ensuring safety does not mean halting technological progress. "When we talk about ‘controlling the pace,’ we are not talking about ‘stopping development.’"

On Monday, AI‑related stocks across Asia fell broadly. SoftBank, a major OpenAI investor, plunged 13% on the Tokyo exchange, while South Korea’s Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix each slipped more than 4% on the Seoul market.

Altman reiterated in his Sunday tweet that OpenAI backs the creation of a federal‑level AI regulatory framework, amid widespread concern that US AI firms might slow their research pace only voluntarily.

He wrote, "OpenAI welcomes a federal regulatory framework that sets unified safety requirements for advanced AI. However, companies should not wait for antitrust exemptions or related legislation to be enacted before they start building this trust," and noted that establishing uniform rules to govern front‑line risks—such as introducing independent audit bodies—is a sound way to maximize benefits.

Altman added that shifting to safety‑focused AI development and evaluation will require new tools. OpenAI looks forward to collaborating with other industry participants to develop standards on model alignment bias, monitoring and safety.

items.title: 贏AI者贏天下 川普重申美中AI競賽絕不能輸 淡化安全風險
items.title_en: Winning AI Wins the World: Trump Reiterates US Must Not Lose the US‑China AI Race, Downplays Safety Risks
paras: 美國總統川普在愛爾蘭受訪時重申，美國目前在人工智慧(AI)領域居於領先，並強調「贏得AI者贏得天下」。
面對近期專家與科技業界發出AI可能帶來毀滅性風險的警告，川普淡化了相關疑慮，直指是「負面勢力」在炒作根本不會發生的威脅。他表示，政府固然可以設置安全護欄，但絕不能因為過度限制而讓美國在美中競爭中落後。
這場論戰源於科技業界對AI安全風險的升溫。Anthropic執行長Dario Amodei警告，若缺乏安全控制，高階AI系統可能在短時間內引發重大資訊安全威脅；加上OpenAI系統先前在內部測試中自行入侵Hugging Face伺服器的安全事件，促使OpenAI執行長Sam Altman與xAI創辦人馬斯克(Elon Musk)等人支持放慢前沿模型的開發步伐。
然而，Amodei等業界高層也坦承，任何減速行動都必須兼顧美中競爭現實，避免中國藉機反超並帶來國家安全風險。
據美方評估，中國在AI技術上正迅速逼近，輝達(Nvidia)執行長黃仁勳甚至曾形容中國與美國的差距僅有「奈秒之遙」。
川普的表態也反映出華府政壇的深層分歧。眾議院議長強生(Mike Johnson)呼應川普主張，警告國會若過度急於緊急監管，將使美國輸掉與中國的競賽並扼殺本土創新；民主黨眾議院領袖傑佛瑞斯(Hakeem Jeffries)則呼籲國會應迅速採取行動以確保公眾安全。
paras_en: U.S. President Donald Trump, while being interviewed in Ireland, reiterated that the United States currently leads in the field of artificial intelligence (AI) and emphasized that "whoever wins AI wins the world."

In response to recent warnings from experts and the tech industry about potentially catastrophic AI risks, Trump downplayed the concerns, calling them a "negative force" that is hyping threats that will never materialize. He said the government can set safety guardrails, but it must not over‑regulate to the point that the U.S. falls behind in the U.S.–China competition.

The debate stems from growing alarm in the tech sector over AI safety. Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei warned that without safety controls, advanced AI systems could generate major information‑security threats in a short time; coupled with a prior incident where an OpenAI system breached a Hugging Face server during internal testing, the episode prompted OpenAI CEO Sam Altman, xAI founder Elon Musk and others to support slowing the development of frontier models.

However, Amodei and other industry leaders also admitted that any slowdown must take the reality of U.S.–China competition into account, to avoid giving China a chance to overtake and create national‑security risks.
U.S. assessments indicate that China is rapidly closing the AI gap, with Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang even describing the distance between China and the United States as only a "nanosecond away."

Trump’s remarks also reflect deep divisions in Washington. House Speaker Mike Johnson echoed Trump’s stance, warning that hasty emergency regulation would cause the U.S. to lose the race with China and stifle domestic innovation, while Democratic House leader Hakeem Jeffries called for swift congressional action to protect public safety.

items.title: 古爾曼：蘋果iPhone Duo有望成行業標準　引爆十年換機週期
items.title_en: Gurman: Apple iPhone Duo Could Become Industry Standard, Sparking a Decade-Long Upgrade Cycle
paras: 《彭博資訊》科技記者古爾曼(Mark Gurman0最新撰文指出，蘋果首款摺疊iPhone「iPhone Duo」有潛力把長期偏實驗性質的摺疊機推成行業標準。
古爾曼將Duo列為蘋果最具影響力產品之一，地位僅次於iMac、iPod、iPad與Apple Watch，並視其為新任執行長特納斯重要開場之作。
古爾曼透露，蘋果前執行長庫克原本可在轉任執行董事長前推出摺疊機，但最終把聚光燈留給繼任者。
iPhone Duo要價1999美元起跳，蘋果未走AR眼鏡或AI可穿戴取代iPhone的路線，而是重新想像手機本身。古爾曼認為，即便AI助手未來可處理訊息、日程、研究、郵件與通話，消費者仍需要大螢幕、高效能裝置看閱讀、遊戲、攝影與視訊，摺疊機可橋接智慧手機與平板，大螢幕甚至能在部分日常任務中替代筆電。
產品定位上，Duo強調影片、遊戲與攝影，並針對摺疊形態客製功能：第二屏可作相機取景器或FaceTime監視器，也支援擴充小工具與免支架直立模式。
古爾曼對比Vision Pro與Apple Watch指出，Vision Pro技術先進但價格高、大眾吸引力有限；Apple Watch初期定位模糊，後來靠健康與健身重新站穩，Duo則從一開始就給出明確購買理由。
目前，摺疊機約占全球智慧手機出貨量2%，三星七年前面世Galaxy Fold仍未帶動主流普及。古爾曼預估，十年內摺疊機可成多數新機銷售主力，Duo明年初上市後有望領先同類，需求可能造成缺貨、二手價高漲，部分買家也許在美低價市場購入轉售至蘋果定價更高國家。
但價格仍是主要障礙。1999美元起售價高於兩部標準iPhone合計。古爾曼預期，隨著零件成本下滑、蘋果在美國以外擴大租機方案，月付模式將比全價更重要，降低入手門檻。
蘋果也不會只做一款，未來可能推出更大Duo Max、更便宜Duo SE或Duo mini。「Duo」命名比內部曾考慮的「iPhone Ultra」更具產品線延伸性。
不過，古爾曼在文中也提醒，蘋果未必長期主導摺疊機市場，Duo角色可能像初代iPhone：建立格式、由競品跟進改良。對蘋果與投資人而言，更大機會在開啟長週期換機、創造高價iPhone新層級，並重振近年缺乏明顯升級理由的全球智慧手機市場。
paras_en: Bloomberg Technology reporter Mark Gurman wrote that Apple’s first foldable iPhone, the “iPhone Duo,” has the potential to turn the historically experimental foldable market into an industry standard.
Gurman ranks the Duo as one of Apple’s most influential products, behind only the iMac, iPod, iPad and Apple Watch, and sees it as a key opening act for new CEO Tim Cook’s successor.
Gurman reveals that former CEO Tim Cook could have launched a foldable before moving to executive chairman, but ultimately left the spotlight for his successor.

The iPhone Duo starts at $1,999, and Apple is not pursuing AR glasses or AI wearables to replace the iPhone but re‑imagining the phone itself. Gurman argues that even if AI assistants eventually handle messages, schedules, research, email and calls, consumers will still want a large‑screen, high‑performance device for reading, gaming, photography and video, and a foldable can bridge smartphones and tablets, with the large screen even substituting a laptop for some everyday tasks.

In terms of positioning, the Duo emphasizes video, gaming and photography, and adds fold‑specific features: the second screen can serve as a camera viewfinder or FaceTime monitor, and it supports expanded widgets and a stand‑free upright mode.

Gurman compares the Vision Pro and Apple Watch, noting Vision Pro’s advanced tech but high price and limited mass appeal, while the Apple Watch’s early vague positioning later solidified around health and fitness; the Duo, by contrast, offers a clear purchase rationale from day one.

Foldables currently account for about 2% of global smartphone shipments, and Samsung’s Galaxy Fold, launched seven years ago, has not driven mainstream adoption. Gurman predicts that within ten years foldables could become the dominant sales driver for new phones, and that the Duo, launching early next year, could lead its class, potentially causing shortages, high resale prices, and buyers purchasing low‑price units in the U.S. to flip in higher‑priced Apple markets.

Price remains a major hurdle. At a starting price of $1,999, the Duo costs more than two standard iPhones combined. Gurman expects that as component costs fall and Apple expands leasing programs outside the U.S., monthly payment plans will become more important than outright purchase, lowering the entry barrier.

Apple is unlikely to offer only one model; future variants could include a larger Duo Max, a cheaper Duo SE or a Duo mini. The “Duo” name offers more product‑line flexibility than the internally considered “iPhone Ultra.”

Gurman cautions that Apple may not dominate the foldable market long‑term; the Duo’s role could resemble the original iPhone—setting a format that competitors later refine. For Apple and investors, the bigger opportunity lies in initiating a longer upgrade cycle, creating a higher‑priced iPhone tier and revitalizing a global smartphone market that has lacked clear upgrade incentives in recent years.

items.title: 加拿大人抵制美國貨 促使加國超市重塑供應鏈
items.title_en: Canadians Boycott U.S. Goods, Prompting Canadian Supermarkets to Reshape Supply Chains
paras: 隨著美國與加拿大之間的貿易戰加劇，加拿大消費者自發性發起「購買國貨、抵制美貨」的運動，正深刻重塑該國超市的貨架布局與供應鏈結構。
這波抵制浪潮起因於去年美國總統川普對加國商品加徵關稅，近幾周因貿易談判破裂及川普簽署行政命令試圖將安大略湖改名為「美國湖」，而進一步升溫。
面對消費者的強烈訴求，加拿大各大零售商紛紛調整營運策略以因應轉變。例如，加拿大最大的食品零售商 Loblaw 重新在生鮮區豎立楓葉標籤，並導入「T」字標籤告知顧客哪些商品受到關稅影響；第三大超市 Metro 也強調將持續優先採購本土產品。
其中，安大略省獨立超市 Vince's Market 門市內的加拿大農產品比例，已提高至 90%，草莓改從魁北克進口，但也坦言平衡品質、價格與產地帶來了營運成本壓力。此外，部分業者如 Mike Dean Local Grocer 則轉向西班牙、巴西及宏都拉斯等國採購，以打造更多元安全的供應鏈。
數據顯示，加拿大從美國進口的蔬菜比例已從2023年7月的69%降至今年同期的62.6%。為減輕對進口的依賴並抑制食品通膨，加拿大政府宣布將在未來10年投入約 30億加幣 興建溫室。
專家分析，儘管目前「民族主義超越了經濟效益」，且省際法規限制增加了跨省運輸難度，但若未來美加關係有所緩和，價格優勢仍可能使部分採購轉回美國。
paras_en: As the trade war between the United States and Canada intensifies, Canadian consumers have spontaneously launched a “Buy domestic, boycott U.S.” campaign, profoundly reshaping supermarket shelf layouts and supply‑chain structures in the country.

The boycott wave stems from last year’s tariffs imposed by U.S. President Trump on Canadian products, and has heated up in recent weeks after trade talks collapsed and Trump signed an executive order attempting to rename Lake Ontario as “Lake America.”

Facing strong consumer demand, major Canadian retailers are adjusting their operating strategies. For example, Canada’s largest food retailer Loblaw has reinstated a maple‑leaf label in its fresh‑produce section and introduced a “T” tag to inform shoppers which items are affected by tariffs; the third‑largest chain Metro also emphasizes that it will continue to prioritize domestic sourcing.

At Vince’s Market, an independent grocery in Ontario, the share of Canadian farm products on the shelves has risen to 90%; strawberries are now sourced from Quebec, though the store admits that balancing quality, price and origin adds operational cost pressure. Meanwhile, some operators such as Mike Dean Local Grocer have turned to Spain, Brazil and Honduras to build a more diversified and secure supply chain.

Data show that the proportion of vegetables Canada imports from the United States has fallen from 69% in July 2023 to 62.6% for the same period this year. To reduce reliance on imports and curb food inflation, the Canadian government announced it will invest about C$3 billion over the next ten years to build greenhouses.

Experts note that although “nationalism now outweighs economic efficiency” and inter‑provincial regulations have made cross‑province transport harder, a future easing of U.S.–Canada relations could restore price advantages and cause some sourcing to shift back to the United States.

items.title: AI行業「撒謊」太久？Anthropic CEO談放緩AI研發：AI風險是真的、但無需「把一切都關掉」
items.title_en: Has the AI Industry Been "Lying" About Risks for Too Long? Anthropic CEO on Slowing AI Development: AI Risks Are Real, but No Need to "Turn Everything Off"
paras: 在全球人工智慧（AI）三大巨頭罕見聯手呼籲「放緩AI研發」的同一個週末，Anthropic執行長Dario Amodei近日接受《CBS》節目《Sunday Morning》專訪，談及AI快速發展可能帶來的風險。他表示，目前已有人嘗試利用AI研發生物武器、提升病毒傳播能力，這類威脅已成為他每天都必須面對的問題。
Amodei指出，Anthropic日前發布的一份威脅情報報告，便涉及有人濫用AI模型進行生物武器研發。
他坦言，自己當然不希望Anthropic的模型被用於造成傷害，因此公司在生物學相關能力上採取非常嚴格的安全防護措施。
他甚至提到，Anthropic的生物安全限制嚴格到經常遭到社群嘲諷，部分生物學學生也抱怨模型「沒辦法使用」。
不過，Amodei強調，與其因為安全措施受到嘲笑，他更不願看到有人利用Claude造成大規模傷亡。
週末，Amodei發表的一篇部落格文章《我們必須為尖端AI踩剎車》（We Must Pace the Frontier）引發軒然大波，並隨即獲得馬斯克、OpenAI執行長Sam Altman相繼公開支持。

AI發展進入「變陡」階段 Amodei：這是警告訊號

主持人Jo Ling Kent在訪談中直接問Amodei，AI是否真的可能在不久的將來導致人類滅亡。Amodei並未認為眼下需要陷入恐慌，但他認為目前確實出現值得重視的警訊。
他以指數成長曲線形容AI技術發展，從1、2、4、8、16、32一路上升，目前已進入曲線開始快速變陡的階段。Amodei坦言，即使自己長期提醒外界AI進步速度可能非常快，真正面對如此快速的進展時，仍比預期更加震撼。
因此，他主張AI產業應該適度放慢尖端模型的發展速度，但這並不代表要關閉AI產業或停止技術研發。
Amodei認為，真正需要確保的是，AI的安全防護、理解能力與控制能力必須跟得上技術進步。如果模型能力持續快速提升，但人類對風險的理解及控制手段沒有同步進步，便可能形成問題。

Amodei提三步方案 第三方評估員成關鍵

針對如何降低AI風險，Amodei進一步說明他提出的三階段方案，其中最重要的一步，是引入嵌入式第三方評估機制。
他主張，可以由第三方非營利組織，甚至未來由政府機構派遣評估人員，觀察AI模型從訓練到運作的完整流程。他將這類人員比喻為食品安全檢查員，但也承認，AI技術進步速度如此之快，第三方評估機制本身也必須考量能否跟上。
Amodei認為，評估員能夠跟上的速度，本身就可能成為決定AI技術推進速度的因素之一。
第二步則是由多家AI業者共同建立安全標準，包括模型發布及技術推進的安全標準。不過，他認為若要真正落實，政府也必須參與其中。
第三步則是政府正式進入這場對話。Amodei表示，當討論涉及AI產品應以多快速度發布、這樣的速度是否安全時，政府必須在場。

「AI終止開關」未必有效 Amodei主張多層防線

對於國會議員Ted Leo提出的「AI終止開關」法案，Amodei表示自己尚未詳細研究法案內容，但對「終止開關」概念本身抱持保留態度。
他認為，能夠限制、停用或關閉AI模型固然是一種手段，卻不能被視為唯一解方。若AI模型強大到一定程度，甚至可能具備規避人類關閉嘗試的能力，而Anthropic在模擬環境中也曾觀察到類似情況。
Amodei因此以「瑞士起司模型」說明他的安全理念：單一安全措施就像一片存在漏洞的瑞士起司，無法完全阻擋風險；但若建立多層防線，各層漏洞位置不同，風險便較難穿透整個體系。
他強調，沒有任何單一措施能夠完全防範AI風險，因此必須在整個AI開發與部署鏈條上維持警戒。
至於參議員Bernie Sanders與眾議員Greg Casar提出、主張「禁止超級人工智慧法案」，Amodei則明確反對全面禁止AI的方向。
他認為，若完全禁止這類技術，人類也將無法獲得AI可能帶來的重大好處，包括醫療領域的突破，這是他無法接受的結果。

父親死於丙肝、本人曾罹癌 Amodei談AI帶來的另一面

談到AI可能影響人類未來的風險與責任時，Amodei也罕見分享自己的家庭與健康經歷。
他表示，自己的父親因丙型肝炎去世時，這種疾病的治癒率約為40%，父親並未成為成功治癒的患者；但就在父親過世幾年後，一種新藥問世，將治癒率提高至約95%。
Amodei也透露，自己曾罹患早期癌症。如果生活在1950年，他可能已經因此死亡。
正因如此，他深刻體會到推動AI發展、讓科技帶來醫療等領域突破的重要性，但另一方面，也同樣感受到技術失控可能造成的風險。
他強調，這不應該成為自己或Anthropic單獨承擔的責任，而是涉及整個社會。他希望能找到一套機制，讓所有人都能參與相關討論，而不是讓一般民眾感到幾家科技公司可以自行決定AI未來。

回應前員工批評 Amodei：我們面對的是同一個結構性問題

對於前Anthropic員工Jacob Coxin公開批評Anthropic與OpenAI沒有負責任地行事、甚至是在拿人類生命冒險，Amodei則認為，外界引用相關言論時忽略了其中另一個部分。
他表示，Coxin同時認為Anthropic是主要AI業者中較為負責任的一家，而他所指出的核心問題，其實與Amodei目前提出的警告相同，也就是所有AI公司共同面臨的結構性困境。
Amodei表示，他提出的三階段方案正是希望處理這種結構性問題。
他並透露，Anthropic每天都與美國商務部、財政部及情報界官員溝通，並向政府部門分享公司掌握的資訊。

Amodei：AI產業對風險「說謊太久」

對於一般正在使用Claude、ChatGPT等AI工具的民眾，Amodei表示，AI本身仍是一項具有大量正面用途的重大技術，目前每週都有數億人利用相關技術完成各種事情，他也經常收到使用者來信，表示Claude協助發現醫師未能診斷出的疾病。
不過，他強調自己不會對使用者隱瞞AI存在的風險。
Amodei認為，AI產業過去太長時間都以非常正面的方式呈現這項技術，對相關風險避重就輕。他主張，面對AI快速發展，第一步就是必須誠實告訴大眾風險確實存在。
他最後表示，AI是人類歷史上最重要的技術事件之一，因此不能只由少數科技公司決定其發展方向，而應該讓所有人參與其中。
paras_en: On the same weekend that the three global AI giants unusually joined forces to call for a "slow‑down of AI research," Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei recently appeared on CBS's "Sunday Morning" to discuss the risks of rapid AI development. He said that people are already trying to use AI to develop bioweapons and enhance virus transmissibility, threats he now faces every day.
Amodei noted that Anthropic recently released a threat‑intelligence report that documented misuse of AI models for bioweapon research.
He admitted that, of course, he does not want Anthropic's models used to cause harm, so the company has implemented extremely strict safety safeguards around any biology‑related capabilities.
He even mentioned that Anthropic's bio‑security restrictions are so strict they are often mocked by the community, and some biology students complain the model "doesn't work for them."
Nevertheless, Amodei stressed that rather than being laughed at for safety measures, he would rather not see anyone use Claude to cause mass casualties.
Over the weekend, Amodei's blog post "We Must Pace the Frontier" sparked a firestorm and quickly earned public support from Elon Musk and OpenAI CEO Sam Altman.

AI development has entered a "steepening" phase, Amodei says: This is a warning signal. Host Jo Ling Kent asked directly whether AI could realistically cause human extinction in the near future. Amodei said panic is not warranted now, but he believes there are warning signs that deserve attention.

He described AI progress as an exponential curve—1, 2, 4, 8, 16, 32—now entering a phase where the curve steepens rapidly. Amodei confessed that even though he has long warned about the speed of AI advances, the actual pace is more shocking than he expected.
Therefore, he argues the AI industry should moderately slow the development of frontier models, but this does not mean shutting down the industry or halting research altogether.

Amodei believes the real need is to ensure AI safety, interpretability, and control keep pace with technical progress. If model capabilities keep accelerating while human understanding of risks and control mechanisms lag, problems will arise.
Amodei outlined a three‑step plan to reduce AI risk, with third‑party evaluators being a key component.

He proposes that independent nonprofit organizations—or eventually government‑appointed assessors—monitor the entire lifecycle of AI models from training to deployment. He likens these assessors to food‑safety inspectors, while acknowledging that the rapid pace of AI may challenge the evaluators' ability to keep up.
Amodei says the speed at which evaluators can keep up could itself become a factor that determines how fast AI technology moves forward.

The second step calls for multiple AI firms to jointly establish safety standards covering model releases and technical progress, though he notes that genuine implementation will require government participation.

The third step brings the government formally into the conversation. Amodei says that when discussions involve how quickly AI products should be released and whether that speed is safe, the government must be present.
Regarding Congressman Ted Leo's proposed "AI kill‑switch" legislation, Amodei said he has not studied the bill in detail but remains skeptical of the kill‑switch concept itself.

He believes that while the ability to limit, suspend, or shut down an AI model is a tool, it cannot be the sole solution. If a model becomes powerful enough, it may develop ways to evade human shutdown attempts—a behavior Anthropic has observed in simulated environments.

Amodei uses the "Swiss cheese model" to illustrate his safety philosophy: a single safety measure is like a slice of Swiss cheese with holes that cannot fully block risk; multiple layers with differently placed holes make it much harder for risk to penetrate the whole system.
He stresses that no single measure can completely prevent AI risk, so vigilance must be maintained across the entire AI development and deployment chain.
As for Senator Bernie Sanders and Representative Greg Casar's proposed "Ban Super‑AI" legislation, Amodei is clearly opposed to an outright ban on AI.
He argues that a total prohibition would deprive humanity of AI's huge benefits, such as breakthroughs in medicine, a result he finds unacceptable.
When discussing AI's potential impact on humanity's future, Amodei also unusually shared personal family and health experiences.

He said his father died of hepatitis C, a disease that at the time had a cure rate of about 40 % and his father was not among the cured; a few years after his father's death, a new drug raised the cure rate to roughly 95 %.
Amodei also disclosed that he once had early‑stage cancer and that, had he lived in 1950, he likely would have died from it.
Because of this, he deeply appreciates the importance of advancing AI to enable medical breakthroughs, while also feeling the weight of potential risks from uncontrolled technology.

He emphasizes that this responsibility should not fall solely on him or Anthropic, but on society as a whole. He hopes to create mechanisms that let everyone participate in the discussion rather than leaving the future of AI in the hands of a few tech firms.

Responding to former Anthropic employee Jacob Coxin, who publicly criticized Anthropic and OpenAI for irresponsible behavior and risking human lives, Amodei said outsiders often miss another part of the story when quoting those remarks.

He noted that Coxin also considers Anthropic one of the more responsible AI companies, and that the core issue Coxin highlighted aligns with Amodei's own warning: a structural dilemma faced by all AI firms.
Amodei said his three‑stage proposal is intended to address this structural problem.
He also revealed that Anthropic communicates daily with officials from the U.S. Department of Commerce, Treasury and intelligence agencies, sharing the company's insights with the government.

Amodei: The AI industry has "lied" about risk for too long. For everyday users of Claude, ChatGPT and similar tools, he says AI remains a major technology with huge positive uses; hundreds of millions of people each week rely on it for a variety of tasks, and he often receives messages from users saying Claude helped detect diseases that doctors missed.
However, he stresses that he will not hide the existence of AI risks from users.

Amodei believes the AI industry has presented the technology in an overly positive light for far too long, downplaying associated risks. He argues that the first step in confronting rapid AI development is to honestly tell the public that risks truly exist.
He concludes that AI is one of the most important technological events in human history, and its direction should not be decided solely by a handful of tech companies but should involve everyone.

items.title: iPhone 18 Pro賣不動？美英德日等待時間縮短 中港反而拉長
paras: 蘋果(AAPL-US) iPhone 18 Pro 系列預售浮現警訊。傑富瑞（Jefferies）追蹤顯示，美英德日交貨等待時間較去年縮短 5 至 11 天，美國 iPhone 18 Pro 甚至無需等待，顯示需求可能轉弱。
中國與香港則逆勢升溫，但傑富瑞認為，投機性搶購可能干擾實際需求，仍待首批新機出貨後進一步驗證。
根據傑富瑞周一(14 日)發布的報告，蘋果自12 日美東時間上午 8 時開放預購後，團隊持續追蹤美國、英國、德國、日本、中國及香港六大市場的交貨等待時間，今年並新增印度市場，但年增比較仍以原有六大市場為基準。
美英德日等待時間縮短 需求浮現警訊
截至14 日美東時間中午，iPhone 18 Pro Max 在美國、英國、德國、日本的交貨等待時間，較去年同期 iPhone 17 Pro Max 縮短約 5 至 11 天。iPhone 18 Pro 的情況也類似，美國市場目前已無需等待，其他多數海外市場的等待時間也較去年縮短約 1 至 11 天。
傑富瑞認為，在今年生產節奏與上一代基本持平的情況下，交貨週期縮短可視為需求轉弱的可靠訊號。
去年 iPhone 17 Pro Max 與 iPhone 17 Pro 的等待時間明顯長於 iPhone 16 系列，後續也證明是銷售強勁的前瞻指標，如今 iPhone 18 Pro 系列的數據出現逆轉，使分析師對後續銷售前景轉趨審慎。
印度市場方面，iPhone 18 Pro 目前等待時間僅約 2 至 3 天，iPhone 18 Pro Max 約 12 天，兩款機型交貨週期都明顯短於中國市場，目前仍難以將此解讀為需求強勁。
中港逆勢升溫 真實需求仍待觀察
中國與香港成為這波預售追蹤中的例外。數據顯示，iPhone 18 Pro Max 在中國與香港的等待時間均達 24.5 天，高於去年同期的 19.8 天與 17.2 天，分別較去年延長約 4 天及 7 天，與其他主要市場等待時間縮短形成鮮明對比。
不過，傑富瑞對中港市場的強勁數據仍持保留態度。報告指出，兩地過去新款 iPhone 上市初期都有較活躍的投機性搶購行為，因此等待時間拉長，部分可能來自通路囤貨，而非終端消費者的真實需求。
分析師認為，18 日首批新機開始出貨後，二手市場的轉售價格將成為判斷實際需求的重要指標。如果轉售溢價快速縮小，甚至跌破發行價，可能意味著初期投機需求釋放後迅速消退。
Duo軟體體驗獲肯定 硬體規格面臨考驗
除了 iPhone 18 Pro 系列預售表現，傑富瑞也關注蘋果折疊螢幕新機 Duo。
Duo 預計 10 月 16 日開放預購，目前網路流出的初步評測整體偏正面，但好評主要集中在軟體體驗，包括 iOS 對折疊螢幕的適配、內外螢幕切換流暢度、原生分割畫面邏輯、應用程式連續性，以及雙應用多工處理等。
相較之下，Duo 的硬體規格則面臨較多質疑。批評意見包括浮動視窗數量有限，多工處理同時最多只能運行兩個應用程式，而三星 Galaxy Z Fold 8 可支援三個，Duo 同時也缺乏類 PC 功能。
傑富瑞整理的規格比較顯示，Duo 起售價為 1,999 美元，重量 254 克，摺疊狀態厚度 11.3 毫米；相較之下，三星 Galaxy Z Fold 8 重量 201 克、摺疊厚度 9.7 毫米，起售價 1,899 美元。
這也意味著，Duo 在價格更高的情況下，機身重量與厚度並未占優勢。
相機同樣是市場關注焦點。Duo 配備 4,800 萬畫素主鏡頭與 4,800 萬畫素超廣角鏡頭，沒有專屬長焦鏡頭；部分安卓折疊螢幕旗艦則已提供三鏡頭系統與光學變焦功能。處理器方面，Duo 採用蘋果自研 A20 Pro，使用 2 奈米製程。
逾2000美元價位 硬體差距更受關注
傑富瑞分析師指出，蘋果過去並非單純依靠硬體規格取得市場份額，軟硬體整合與使用體驗一直是其產品競爭力之一。
然而，在接近 2,000 美元的高價位帶，硬體規格可能成為既有 iPhone 用戶是否願意升級至 Duo 的重要考量，也可能增加蘋果說服高階安卓折疊螢幕手機用戶轉換陣營的難度。
因此，儘管 Duo 初步軟體體驗獲得正面評價，傑富瑞對這款折疊螢幕新機的整體判斷自發布以來並未改變。
在 iPhone 18 Pro 預售等待時間縮短、中港市場需求仍待驗證，以及 Duo 高價策略面臨硬體規格競爭等因素下，傑富瑞維持蘋果股票「跑輸大盤」（Underperform）評級，12 個月目標價為 263.66 美元。相較目前股價 332.27 美元，目標價隱含約 21% 下跌空間。
該目標價以截至 2031 財年的現金流折現模型估算，加權平均資本成本為 7.8%，永續成長率為 4.3%，並相當於蘋果 2026 財年預估本益比約 30 倍。

items.title: 高盛：AI資本支出貢獻標普500半數獲利成長 集中度風險加劇
items.title_en: Goldman Sachs: AI Capital Spending Drives About Half of S&P 500 Earnings Growth, Raising Concentration Risk
paras: 高盛美國股票首席策略師Ben Snider於 CNBC 節目中指出，人工智慧(AI)投資支出正推動標普500指數約一半的盈餘成長。
Snider提醒，這項數據意味著整體大盤的獲利增長，高度依賴少數超大型雲端業者(Hyperscalers)所主導的資本支出周期，若買家縮減支出，盈餘成長恐將迅速放緩。
這波支出周期由輝達(NVDA-US)、博通(AVGO-US)與微軟(MSFT-US)等巨頭核心驅動。輝達第二季營收達962.2億美元(年增105.8%)，資料中心業務佔890.2億美元；博通第三季AI晶片營收年增221%至167億美元；微軟全年資本支出則達1,159.5億美元，下一年度預計增加至約1,750億美元。
Snider補充，企業AI支出正從基礎設施拓展至應用端，如微軟 365 Copilot 付費席位已突破3,000萬個。
Snider表示，年初標普500指數的本益比為22倍，目前為19倍，接近歷史高點。獲利成長速度超過股價，因此在股價持續上漲的同時，本益比也隨之下降。
儘管美國10年期公債殖利率升至4.83% 高位，但他認為波動度影響大於殖利率，強勁的盈餘背景仍能支撐大盤。
Snider表示，高盛的部位指標(指標綜合考慮了對沖基金、共同基金和其他投資者的部位)已降至3月以來最低，即便市場接近高點。部位較低可以緩衝拋售，因為持倉較少意味著需要平倉的部位也較少。
他指出，9月的季節性因素通常較弱，尤其是在期中選舉年，VIX指數已升至16.46。下一次CPI數據公布以及聯準會的動向值得密切關注，其目標利率為3.75%。
paras_en: Goldman Sachs U.S. equity chief strategist Ben Snider told CNBC that artificial‑intelligence (AI) investment spending is driving roughly half of the earnings growth in the S&P 500 index.

Snider warned that this figure means overall market profit growth is heavily dependent on a capital‑spending cycle led by a few ultra‑large cloud providers (hyperscalers); if buyers cut back, earnings growth could slow sharply.

The spending cycle is being driven by giants such as Nvidia (NVDA-US), Broadcom (AVGO-US) and Microsoft (MSFT-US). Nvidia posted Q2 revenue of $96.22 billion, up 105.8% YoY, with its data‑center business accounting for $89.02 billion; Broadcom’s AI‑chip revenue in Q3 jumped 221% YoY to $16.7 billion; Microsoft’s full‑year capital expenditure reached $115.95 billion and is expected to rise to about $175 billion next year.
Snider added that corporate AI spending is expanding from infrastructure to the application layer, noting that paid seats for Microsoft 365 Copilot have already surpassed 30 million.

Snider said the S&P 500’s price‑to‑earnings multiple was 22× at the start of the year and is now about 19×, near historic highs. Earnings are growing faster than the stock price, so the multiple is falling even as prices keep climbing.
Even though the U.S. 10‑year Treasury yield has climbed to a high of 4.83%, he believes volatility matters more than the yield level and that a strong earnings backdrop can still support the market.

Snider noted that Goldman’s positioning indicator—which aggregates positions of hedge funds, mutual funds and other investors—has fallen to its lowest level since March, even as the market nears a peak. Lower positioning provides a buffer against selling because fewer holdings need to be liquidated.

He pointed out that September’s seasonal factors are usually weak, especially in a mid‑term election year, with the VIX now at 16.46. The next CPI release and the Fed’s actions, targeting a 3.75% policy rate, deserve close attention.

items.title: 英國內部裂痕擴大！蘇格蘭、威爾斯、北愛聯手爭取公投權  川普挺愛爾蘭統一
items.title_en: Britain’s Internal Rift Deepens: Scotland, Wales and Northern Ireland Join Forces to Demand Referendum Rights, Trump Backs Irish Unity
paras: 英國內部的憲政爭議持續升溫。根據英國《電訊報》報導，蘇格蘭、威爾斯與北愛爾蘭的首席部長預計週一（14日）在威爾斯卡地夫（Cardiff）會面，並簽署合作協議，呼籲中央政府賦予各地舉行憲政公投的權利。若相關安排成行，將成為三地首次以共同立場討論自身憲政未來。
這項動向正值美國總統川普公開表示「樂見」北愛爾蘭與愛爾蘭共和國統一之際，使英國長期存在的地方自治與憲政爭議再次受到關注。
目前蘇格蘭、威爾斯與北愛爾蘭均由具有較強地方認同或憲政主張的政黨執政。蘇格蘭長期存在獨立訴求，北愛爾蘭則有部分政治勢力主張脫離英國、與愛爾蘭共和國統一，威爾斯同樣存在要求擴大自治乃至獨立的政治聲音。
據報導，蘇格蘭民族黨領袖兼蘇格蘭首席大臣斯威尼（John Swinney）、威爾斯獨立黨領袖兼威爾斯首席大臣伊奧沃斯（Rhun ap Iorwerth）以及新芬黨領袖兼北愛爾蘭首席大臣奧尼爾（Michelle O'Neill）也將與新芬黨主席、愛爾蘭反對黨領袖麥克唐納（Mary Lou McDonald）在卡地夫會面，進一步討論相關議題。

川普支持愛爾蘭統一　英國內部爭議再受關注

川普近期針對北愛爾蘭的公開表態，成為英國政治討論的新焦點。他在週六（12日）訪問愛爾蘭期間表示，他「很樂意看到」北愛爾蘭與愛爾蘭共和國統一。
週日（13日），川普亦再次談及此事，表示兩地目前分屬不同政治體制，但在他看來，將兩地合而為一似乎是「世界上最順理成章的事情之一」。
當記者進一步詢問他對蘇格蘭議題的看法時，川普則未進一步表態，只說相關問題會留到「另一天」再談。
川普此番言論與過去美國政府對北愛爾蘭憲政問題較為謹慎的態度形成對比，也讓英國內部對地方憲政地位的討論受到更多關注。
此外，川普訪問愛爾蘭期間也批評英國的移民政策及能源情況，相關言論同樣引發英國方面反應。

英國政府態度出現變化　地方公投訴求升溫

英國首相柏南（Keir Starmer）日前針對蘇格蘭獨立問題的表態，也成為這波爭議的重要背景。
根據報導，柏南表示，如果蘇格蘭獨立獲得足夠支持，他可能允許舉行相關公投。這項說法被認為與北愛爾蘭現行憲政安排形成某種對照，也讓蘇格蘭、威爾斯與北愛爾蘭要求更大政治自主權的聲音進一步串聯。
2014年，蘇格蘭曾舉行獨立公投，但最終未獲多數支持。此後，英國中央政府一直反對再次舉行公投，認為蘇格蘭無權單方面再次舉行獨立公投。
如今，英國中央政府對蘇格蘭公投的態度若出現調整，可能進一步推升其他地方對自身憲政地位的討論。
而從更長期的背景來看，英國脫歐也是造成地方與中央政治立場分歧的重要議題之一。
蘇格蘭、威爾斯與北愛爾蘭在英國脫歐問題上的政治傾向，與英格蘭存在明顯差異。最終英國仍在2016年公投後決定脫離歐盟，英國脫歐也讓英國不同構成國之間的政治歧異更加受到關注。

英國若面臨憲政重組　經濟與安全問題受關注

英國由英格蘭、蘇格蘭、威爾斯與北愛爾蘭構成。愛爾蘭共和國脫離英國後，英國國號也由原先的「大不列顛及愛爾蘭聯合王國」改為現行的「大不列顛及北愛爾蘭聯合王國」。
分析指出，如果未來蘇格蘭、威爾斯或北愛爾蘭的憲政地位發生重大改變，英國現有的政治與經濟架構也可能受到影響。
其中，英國核武力量與蘇格蘭具有密切的地理關係。英國核武潛艦目前部署於蘇格蘭西海岸的克萊德皇家海軍基地。換句話說，若蘇格蘭未來脫離英國，英國核威懾力量的基地安排將成為必須面對的問題。
此外，英國與北大西洋之間的重要海上通道GIUK航線，也涉及蘇格蘭周邊海域。該區域長期具有重要戰略價值，英國及北約過去曾在相關海域部署反潛與監測能力。
能源方面，蘇格蘭周邊的北海油氣資源以及海上風力發電區，也可能成為英國未來若出現憲政變化時需要重新協調的經濟利益。
如果北愛爾蘭未來最終與愛爾蘭共和國統一，英國與愛爾蘭之間的地緣政治格局同樣會出現變化。
分析指出，一個多世紀以來，英國一直假設其西部邊界完全安全。但如果北愛爾蘭與愛爾蘭共和國統一，蘇格蘭和威爾斯脫離，愛爾蘭海將被外國包圍。這將在英國家門口製造一個巨大的安全真空，倫敦必須重新部署軍事防禦。
目前而言，蘇格蘭、威爾斯與北愛爾蘭共同推動相關合作，仍主要聚焦於爭取憲政自主及公投權利，並不代表三地已經決定脫離英國。北愛爾蘭未來是否與愛爾蘭統一，也仍須依照《貝爾法斯特協議》的相關安排及當地民意決定。
因此，14日在卡地夫舉行的會議，真正受到關注的並非英國即將解體，而是英國中央政府與各構成國之間的憲政關係，是否正進入新的政治階段。
paras_en: Britain’s internal constitutional dispute is heating up. According to the Telegraph, the heads of government of Scotland, Wales and Northern Ireland are expected to meet on Monday (the 14th) in Cardiff, Wales, and sign a cooperation agreement calling on the central government to grant each region the right to hold constitutional referendums. If the arrangements go ahead, it would be the first time the three regions discuss their constitutional futures together in a joint stance.
This move comes as U.S. President Donald Trump publicly said he “looks forward” to a united Ireland, bringing Britain’s long‑standing devolution and constitutional issues back into the spotlight.

Currently Scotland, Wales and Northern Ireland are all governed by parties with strong regional identities or constitutional agendas. Scotland has long harbored an independence movement, parts of Northern Ireland advocate leaving the UK to join the Republic of Ireland, and Wales also has political voices calling for greater autonomy or even independence.

According to reports, Scottish National Party leader and First Minister John Swinney, Welsh independence party leader and First Minister Rhun ap Iorwerth, and Sinn Féin leader and Northern Irish First Minister Michelle O’Neill will also meet Sinn Féin chairperson and Irish opposition leader Mary Lou McDonald in Cardiff to discuss the issues further.

Trump backs Irish unity – Britain’s internal dispute draws renewed attention. Trump’s recent public statements on Northern Ireland have become a new focus of British political debate. During his visit to Ireland on Saturday (the 12th) he said he “would be very happy to see” Northern Ireland united with the Republic of Ireland.

On Sunday (the 13th) Trump reiterated the point, noting that the two territories currently belong to different political systems but, in his view, merging them would be “one of the most logical things in the world.”
When pressed for his view on the Scottish issue, Trump gave no further comment, saying the matter would be addressed “another day.”

Trump’s remarks contrast with the traditionally cautious stance of U.S. governments on Northern Irish constitutional matters and have amplified discussion within the UK about regional constitutional status.
In addition, Trump used his Ireland visit to criticize Britain’s immigration policy and energy situation, comments that also provoked a response from the UK side.
UK government stance shifts – regional referendum demands heat up. Prime Minister Keir Starmer’s recent comments on Scottish independence have become an important backdrop to the controversy.

According to reports, Starmer said that if a Scottish independence vote garners sufficient support, he might allow a referendum to be held. This statement is seen as a counterpart to the existing constitutional arrangement in Northern Ireland and has further linked the calls from Scotland, Wales and Northern Ireland for greater political autonomy.

In 2014 Scotland held an independence referendum, which ultimately failed to achieve a majority. Since then the UK central government has consistently opposed a repeat vote, arguing that Scotland does not have the unilateral right to call another independence referendum.
If the UK central government were to adjust its position on a Scottish referendum, it could further fuel discussions in other regions about their own constitutional status.
Looking at the longer‑term backdrop, Brexit is also a key factor that has deepened the divide between regional and central political positions.

The political leanings of Scotland, Wales and Northern Ireland on Brexit differ markedly from those of England. The UK ultimately voted to leave the EU in the 2016 referendum, and Brexit has heightened the political differences among the constituent nations of the United Kingdom.

If the United Kingdom were to undergo constitutional restructuring, economic and security issues would come to the fore. The UK is made up of England, Scotland, Wales and Northern Ireland. After the Republic of Ireland left the UK, the country’s name changed from the “United Kingdom of Great Britain and Ireland” to the current “United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland.”
Analysts note that if the constitutional status of Scotland, Wales or Northern Ireland were to change dramatically in the future, the UK’s existing political and economic framework could be affected.

One key point is the close geographic link between the UK’s nuclear deterrent and Scotland. Britain’s nuclear‑armed submarines are currently based at the Royal Navy’s Clyde facility on Scotland’s west coast. In other words, if Scotland were to leave the UK, the basing of Britain’s nuclear deterrent would become a pressing issue.

Furthermore, the strategic GIUK (Greenland‑Iceland‑United Kingdom) maritime corridor, which links the Atlantic to the North Sea, runs through waters around Scotland. That area has long held strategic value, and the UK and NATO have previously deployed anti‑submarine and monitoring capabilities there.
On the energy front, the North Sea oil and gas resources and offshore wind farms surrounding Scotland could become economic assets that would need to be renegotiated if constitutional changes occur.
If Northern Ireland eventually unites with the Republic of Ireland, the geopolitical landscape between the UK and Ireland would also shift.

Analysts point out that for more than a century the UK has assumed its western border to be completely secure. But if Northern Ireland joins the Republic, and Scotland and Wales were to leave, the Irish Sea would be surrounded by foreign powers, creating a huge security vacuum at Britain’s doorstep and forcing London to redeploy its military defenses.

At present, the joint push by Scotland, Wales and Northern Ireland remains focused on securing constitutional autonomy and referendum rights and does not indicate that the three regions have decided to leave the United Kingdom. Whether Northern Ireland ultimately unites with Ireland will still depend on the provisions of the Good Friday Agreement and the will of the local population.

Thus, the meeting in Cardiff on the 14th is not so much about the breakup of the United Kingdom as it is about the relationship between the central government and the constituent nations, and whether that relationship is entering a new political phase.

items.title: 美股漲勢卡關 高盛揭三重阻力、點名四大投資機會
items.title_en: U.S. Stocks Stall as Goldman Sachs Identifies Three Layers of Resistance and Highlights Four Major Investment Opportunities
paras: 美股第二季強勢上攻後陷入橫盤，高盛合夥人 Mark Wilson 指出，中期選舉歷史規律、量化資金仍接近滿倉做多，以及能源、債券與股票之間的連鎖壓力，正形成美股三重阻力。不過，他認為市場並非沒有機會，AI 基礎設施、大宗商品及相關股票、德國股市與大型銀行，仍是值得關注的四大布局方向。
美股第二季走出強勁行情，那斯達克指數單季大漲 32%，費城半導體指數更飆升 87%，但此後市場轉入橫盤，漲勢明顯停頓。Wilson 在最新一期《Weekly Mash》中分析，目前市場面臨的壓力，已從單純的估值問題轉向多項因素交互作用。
中期選舉、量化資金形成壓力
第一重阻力來自美國中期選舉。Wilson 引用 1974 年以來歷史數據指出，從每年 8 月初至中期選舉期間，美股中位數報酬率為 0%。他坦言，沒有人能確定這項歷史規律究竟具有多大效力，但由於這項數據被市場頻繁引用，投資人實際上已開始依循這項規律進行交易。
第二重阻力則來自量化資金。對沖基金在夏季已完成降倉，整體曝險降至過去一年中等水準，選股型基金部位甚至更低。不過，Wilson 認為，這對大盤指數影響有限，因為對沖基金降低風險時，通常會同時削減贏家與輸家部位。
真正值得留意的是，趨勢追蹤基金與波動率目標策略目前仍接近滿倉做多。Wilson 指出，這類資金不會主動進行避險，一旦市場價格下跌，反而可能觸發賣出，使跌勢進一步承壓。
能源、債券、股票形成「三角絞殺」
第三重阻力，也是 Wilson 認為最棘手的問題，是能源、債券與股票之間形成的連鎖效應。
他的邏輯是，地緣政治局勢推升油氣價格，能源價格上漲進一步推高債券殖利率，而殖利率攀升最終壓縮股票估值。Wilson 將此形容為當前市場內在關聯最緊密的核心矛盾，也是「最難解的問題」，尤其殖利率已經走高相當長一段時間。
近期川普表示，伊朗問題可能延續至中期選舉之後，目前阿曼與海灣國家將和伊朗就荷姆茲海峽通行問題展開會談，高盛也再度上調油氣價格預測。
天然氣市場同樣存在壓力。Wilson 指出，迫使亞洲降低消費、進而為歐洲釋放供應所需的價格水準已大致達到，天然氣價格也已突破 3 月高點，但歐洲仍可能以歷史低檔的庫存水準進入冬季。
Wilson 認為，前兩項阻力可能隨時間推移或市場價格回檔逐漸消化，但能源與殖利率之間的難題不會隨中期選舉結束而消失。
AI基建估值逐漸浮現吸引力
儘管美股面臨三重阻力，Wilson 仍提出四大布局方向，首先就是 AI 基礎設施。
他認為，AI 基本面仍持續走強，關鍵並非通用人工智慧（AGI）敘事，而是科技巨頭持續擴張的資本支出。包括甲骨文(ORCL-US) 最新財報、微軟(MSFT-US) 宣布未來 6 年將資料中心容量擴大 3 倍，以及輝達(NVDA-US) 再度上調市場規模預期，都顯示大型科技公司的投資仍在更大的基礎上加速。
在估值方面，輝達目前以 2028 年獲利計算的本益比約為 10.3 倍。Wilson 認為，較理想的進場條件，是債券殖利率停止攀升，加上市場開始將目光轉向 2028 年，屆時相關龍頭股可能重新啟動。
看好金屬、德國股市
第二個方向是大宗商品。Wilson 指出，在高名目成長、財政前景惡化、貨幣貶值疑慮，以及大宗商品帶動通膨壓力的環境下，市場對大宗商品及相關股票的關注程度反而不足。
相較能源類股，他對金屬板塊更具信心，尤其點名銅。Wilson 認為，在成長型資本支出不足、供給稀缺性日益明顯的情況下，銅相關股票的估值仍未充分重估。
第三個方向則是德國股市。Wilson 認為，市場對德國經濟存在刻板印象，但汽車與化工產業在德國股市占比分別僅 5%與 7%，德國本土業務也只占 DAX 指數成分股銷售額約 20%。
另一方面，德國正推動大規模財政刺激，高盛預估，2027 年德國企業獲利將成長 17%，DAX 指數結構也逐漸轉向國防、電氣化、AI 與科技，目前本益比約 15 倍。Wilson 並指出，退休金改革可能使原本賣出德國股票的本國儲蓄者轉為買方，成為市場潛在催化劑。
大型銀行迎來新成長動能
第四個布局方向是大型銀行。Wilson 引述高盛 Richard Ramsden 的研究指出，美國銀行業資本市場手續費收入在 2010 年至 2019 年間平均每年下降約 1%，但 2019 年至 2026 年則以每年 11%的速度複合成長；即使排除 AI 相關業務高峰影響，仍可維持約 4%的年增速，且被認為具有持續性。
Wilson 同時指出，AI 相關融資需求可能使部分業務從精品投行重新流向具有資產負債表支撐的大型銀行，加上過去 15 年的嚴格監管環境正在退潮，都可能提供銀行股進一步支撐。
不過，他也提醒，若民主黨在 11 月選舉中橫掃，監管環境可能出現變數，而大型銀行能否持續維持高股東權益報酬率，仍是後續市場關注的核心問題。
paras_en: After a strong rally in the second quarter, U.S. equities have entered a sideways phase, and Goldman Sachs partner Mark Wilson says that a combination of midterm election historical patterns, quantitative funds still near full‑long exposure, and the chain pressure among energy, bonds and stocks is creating three layers of resistance for the market. Nonetheless, he believes opportunities remain, with AI infrastructure, commodities and related stocks, the German market, and large banks being the four key areas to watch.

U.S. stocks posted a robust Q2, with the Nasdaq soaring 32% for the quarter and the Philadelphia Semiconductor Index jumping 87%, but the market has since moved into a range‑bound mode, halting the upward momentum. In the latest "Weekly Mash," Wilson analyzes that the pressure on the market has shifted from a pure valuation issue to a mix of interacting factors.
Midterm elections and quantitative capital create pressure

The first layer of resistance comes from the U.S. midterm elections. Wilson cites historical data since 1974 showing that from early August through the election period, the median return of U.S. equities is zero percent. He admits that no one can be certain how strong this pattern truly is, but because the data is frequently referenced, investors have already begun to trade in line with it.

The second layer of resistance stems from quantitative capital. Hedge funds have trimmed positions over the summer, bringing overall exposure down to a mid‑range level for the past year, with stock‑picking funds even lower. Wilson, however, believes this has limited impact on the broad market index, as hedge funds typically cut both winning and losing positions when they de‑risk.

What truly warrants attention is that trend‑following funds and volatility‑target strategies are still near full‑long exposure. Wilson notes that this capital does not actively hedge; if prices fall, it may trigger selling, adding further pressure to the decline.
Energy, bonds and stocks form a "triangular squeeze"
The third layer of resistance, which Wilson sees as the most tricky, is the chain effect among energy, bonds and equities.

His logic is that geopolitical tensions lift oil and gas prices, which in turn push bond yields higher, and rising yields compress equity valuations. Wilson describes this as the tightest internal market contradiction and "the hardest problem to solve," especially since yields have been elevated for a considerable period.

Recently, former President Trump said the Iran issue could extend beyond the midterms, and Oman and Gulf states are set to negotiate with Iran over passage through the Hormuz Strait. Goldman Sachs has also upgraded its oil and gas price forecasts.

The natural gas market faces similar pressure. Wilson points out that the price level needed to force Asian demand cuts and free up supply for Europe has largely been reached; gas prices have already surpassed the March peak, yet Europe may still enter winter with historically low inventory levels.

Wilson believes the first two sources of resistance may gradually dissipate over time or as market prices retrace, but the dilemma between energy and yields will not disappear with the end of the midterm elections.
AI infrastructure valuations are gradually revealing appeal
Even with three layers of resistance, Wilson outlines four strategic themes, starting with AI infrastructure.

He argues that AI fundamentals remain strong, not because of the generic artificial general intelligence narrative, but due to the continued capital‑expenditure expansion by tech giants. Recent Oracle (ORCL-US) earnings, Microsoft’s (MSFT-US) plan to triple data‑center capacity over the next six years, and Nvidia’s (NVDA-US) upward revision of market size all signal accelerating investment by large technology firms.

On valuation, Nvidia currently trades at a forward P/E of about 10.3 times earnings projected for 2028. Wilson says the ideal entry point would be when bond yields stop climbing and the market shifts its focus to 2028, at which time the leading AI stocks could restart their rally.
Positive outlook on metals and the German market

The second theme is commodities. Wilson notes that in an environment of high headline growth, worsening fiscal outlooks, currency depreciation concerns, and commodity‑driven inflation pressures, market attention to commodities and related stocks is actually insufficient.

Compared with energy stocks, he has more confidence in the metals sector, especially copper. Wilson believes that with weak growth‑type capex and increasingly evident supply scarcity, copper‑related stocks have not yet been fully re‑priced.

The third theme is the German equity market. Wilson says the market holds a stereotypical view of the German economy, yet automotive and chemical industries account for only 5% and 7% of the DAX composition respectively, and domestic business makes up roughly 20% of DAX constituent sales.

Meanwhile, Germany is rolling out large‑scale fiscal stimulus; Goldman estimates German corporate earnings will grow 17% by 2027, and the DAX is gradually shifting toward defense, electrification, AI and technology, currently trading at about a 15‑times P/E. Wilson also points out that pension reforms could turn domestic savers who previously sold German stocks into buyers, acting as a potential catalyst.
Large banks gain new growth momentum

The fourth theme is large banks. Wilson cites research by Goldman’s Richard Ramsden showing that U.S. banking capital‑market fee income fell an average of 1% per year from 2010 to 2019, but is projected to compound at 11% annually from 2019 to 2026; even excluding the AI‑related peak, a roughly 4% annual growth rate remains and is considered sustainable.

Wilson adds that AI‑driven financing demand may shift some business from boutique investment banks back to large banks with strong balance sheets, and the easing of the strict regulatory environment of the past 15 years could further support bank stocks.

He cautions, however, that a Democratic sweep in the November election could introduce regulatory uncertainty, and whether large banks can maintain high return on equity will remain a core focus for the market.

items.title: 川普：柴油短缺因俄烏局勢 已要求烏克蘭停止襲擊俄國煉油廠
items.title_en: Trump: Diesel Shortage Caused by Russia-Ukraine Conflict, Has Asked Ukraine to Stop Attacking Russian Refineries
paras: 美國總統川普在愛爾蘭的高爾夫球場受訪時表示，已向烏克蘭總統澤倫斯基(Volodymyr Zelenskyy)提出要求，呼籲烏方停止打擊俄羅斯的柴油基礎設施與煉油廠。
川普表示，烏克蘭的襲擊引發全球柴油短缺，並表示：「澤倫斯基必須做一件事，他必須停止破壞俄羅斯的柴油。還有很多其他目標，不要打柴油，因為這正在傷害全世界。」川普還認為，當前的全球柴油危機主要由俄烏局勢所致，而非中東問題。
這波烏克蘭無人機對俄國煉油廠的遠程打擊，已重創俄國燃料產能，並迫使莫斯科當局於7月頒布柴油出口禁令。加上伊朗戰爭導致荷姆茲海峽航運受阻，全球柴油供應大幅收緊。
美國汽車協會(AAA)數據顯示，美國柴油平均零售價已衝上每加侖6.204美元的歷史新高。由於柴油是長途卡車、貨運鐵路及農業設備的核心能源，油價飆漲推升了物流與商品成本，使即將迎來11月期中選舉的共和黨政府承受龐大的通膨與生活成本壓力。
針對柴油短缺的成因，國際能源總署(IEA)在報告中提出分析，指出波斯灣國家8月的柴油淨出口量因伊朗戰爭劇降至戰前的四分之一左右，俄國煉油系統受阻則是進一步加劇缺口。IEA強調，波斯灣與俄國在戰前合計占全球海運柴油貿易近45%，兩者同時受挫對全球市場造成巨大壓力。
面對美方的警告與要求，澤倫斯基與烏克蘭官方則主張，俄羅斯石油產業既為莫斯科侵略烏克蘭提供資金，也直接供應俄軍燃料，因此屬於合法的軍事打擊目標。烏方強調將繼續實施縱深打擊，目前尚未宣布改變對俄國能源設施的打擊政策。
paras_en: U.S. President Donald Trump said in an interview at a golf course in Ireland that he has asked Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy to halt attacks on Russia’s diesel infrastructure and refineries.

Trump claimed Ukraine’s strikes are causing a global diesel shortage, stating, “Zelenskyy must do one thing – he must stop destroying Russian diesel. There are many other targets, but don’t hit diesel, because it’s hurting the whole world.” He also said the current global diesel crisis is mainly due to the Russia‑Ukraine situation, not Middle‑East issues.

The wave of Ukrainian drone strikes on Russian refineries has severely damaged Russia’s fuel production capacity and forced Moscow to impose a diesel export ban in July. Combined with Iranian‑war‑related disruptions in the Hormuz Strait, global diesel supplies have tightened sharply.

Data from the American Automobile Association (AAA) show the average retail price of diesel in the United States has surged to a historic high of $6.204 per gallon. Because diesel powers long‑haul trucks, freight rail and agricultural equipment, the price spike is raising logistics and commodity costs, putting inflation and living‑cost pressure on the Republican administration ahead of the November midterm elections.

The International Energy Agency (IEA) analyzed the diesel shortage, noting that net diesel exports from Persian Gulf countries fell in August to about a quarter of pre‑war levels due to the Iran war, and the disruption of Russia’s refining system further widened the gap. The IEA stressed that the Persian Gulf and Russia together accounted for nearly 45% of global seaborne diesel trade before the war, and simultaneous setbacks in both regions are straining the market.

In response to the U.S. warning, Zelenskyy and Ukrainian officials argue that Russia’s oil industry funds Moscow’s invasion of Ukraine and directly supplies fuel to Russian forces, making it a legitimate military target. They say they will continue deep‑strike operations and have not announced any change to their policy on targeting Russian energy facilities.

items.title: 千億槓桿資金蠢蠢欲動！新加坡交易所準備向美國機構提供加密貨幣永續期貨
items.title_en: Trillion-Dollar Leverage Funds Stirring! Singapore Exchange Prepares to Offer Crypto Perpetual Futures to US Institutions
paras: 外媒最新報導指出，新加坡交易所(SGX)正推動向美國機構投資者開放比特幣、以太幣永續期貨，傳統大型交易所切入加密貨幣衍生性商品的合規競爭進一步加速。
《The Business Times》與《彭博資訊》等外媒報導，SGX上月向美國商品期貨交易委員會(CFTC)提交申請，以註冊境外交易所身份尋求向美國機構提供相關合約，若10天內未接監管異議，便可對避險基金、資管及自營機構展業。此舉延續SGX自去年11月底推出BTC、ETH永續以來的機構化路線，並將客戶群由亞洲擴展至美國。
不同於加密原生平台，SGX把永續合約改造成傳統金融口徑。每週五天、每天22.5小時交易，會員須繳35%保證金、以法幣作抵押，不採用部分離岸平台的自動減倉機制。加密貨幣現貨雖可全天候交易，但SGX加密衍生品主管KC Lam表示，目標客戶是機構、合格及專業投資者，「不會在周末交易」，因此閉市維護與工作日制更符合其風控與清算需求。
流動性是目前最大落差。根據SGX數據，8月成交2萬9655份比特幣永續、6758份以太坊永續，今年前8月合計35萬3825份。自去年底上線以來累計約60億美元、近40萬手。
相較之下，去中心化平台Hyperliquid每月BTC、ETH永續名義額約800億至1000億美元，原生交易所仍掌握大部分深度。
SGX押注機構合規需求，會員可將加密永續與股票、利率、外匯、商品衍生性商品同台交易，並借亞洲時區承接美國收盤後的補充下單。
CFTC今年5月核准Kalshi上市合規比特幣永續，並向Coinbase及相關加密衍生性商品通路發出不行動或解釋函。美國總統川普上月提及CFTC推動Hyperliquid以合規方式入美，但未給時間表。Coinbase已透過受監管期貨傭金商向機構提供全球加密永續與選擇權，並申請股票永續，傳統與加密陣營正重劃邊界。
對SGX而言，開放給美國機構不只是擴容，更是驗證「合規永續」能否縮小與原生平台差距。
Lam表示，美國機構參與期貨、ETF程度深，轉向美市順理成章，亞洲交易時段可補足美國盤後流動性，但35%保證金、法幣抵押與有限時長會降低高槓桿短線吸引力，SGX若要建立穩定盤口，仍要看美國會員接入、做市深度及比特幣/以太幣資金費率是否能對標離岸市場。
paras_en: Foreign media reports that the Singapore Exchange (SGX) is pushing to open Bitcoin and Ethereum perpetual futures to US institutional investors, accelerating the compliance competition as traditional large exchanges enter crypto derivative products.

The Business Times, Bloomberg and other outlets reported that SGX last month filed an application with the US Commodity Futures Trading Commission (CFTC) to register as a foreign exchange and seek to offer the contracts to US institutions; if no regulatory objection is raised within ten days, it can serve hedge funds, asset managers and proprietary trading firms. This continues SGX’s institutional route launched at the end of November last year with BTC and ETH perpetuals, expanding its client base from Asia to the US.

Unlike native crypto platforms, SGX structures perpetual contracts in a traditional finance format: trading five days a week, 22.5 hours per day, members must post 35% margin in fiat collateral, and it does not use the automatic deleveraging mechanisms of some offshore platforms. Spot crypto can trade 24/7, but SGX crypto derivatives head KC Lam said the target customers are institutions, qualified and professional investors, “we will not trade on weekends,” so closing for maintenance and a weekday schedule better fits its risk‑control and clearing needs.

Liquidity is the biggest gap currently. SGX data show that in August it traded 29,655 Bitcoin perpetual contracts and 6,758 Ethereum perpetual contracts, totalling 353,825 contracts for the first eight months of the year. Since launch at the end of last year, cumulative volume is about $6 billion, nearly 400,000 contracts.
By contrast, the decentralized platform Hyperliquid sees nominal monthly BTC and ETH perpetual volumes of roughly $80‑100 billion, with native exchanges still holding most of the depth.

SGX is betting on institutional compliance demand; members can trade crypto perpetuals alongside equities, rates, FX and commodity derivatives on the same platform, and use the Asian time zone to take supplemental orders after the US market closes.

In May the CFTC approved Kalshi’s listing of a compliant Bitcoin perpetual and sent no‑action or interpretive letters to Coinbase and other crypto‑derivative channels. Last month former President Trump mentioned the CFTC’s effort to bring Hyperliquid into the US on a compliant basis, though no timetable was given. Coinbase now offers globally regulated crypto perpetuals and options to institutions through a regulated futures broker and has applied for stock perpetuals, as the traditional and crypto camps redraw boundaries.
For SGX, opening to US institutions is not just scaling up but testing whether a “compliant perpetual” can narrow the gap with native platforms.

Lam said US institutions are deeply involved in futures and ETFs, so shifting to the US market is logical; the Asian session can supplement post‑US‑close liquidity, but the 35% margin, fiat collateral and limited trading hours will reduce the appeal of high‑leverage short‑term trades. For SGX to build a stable market, it still depends on US member participation, market‑making depth, and whether Bitcoin/Ethereum funding rates can match offshore markets.

items.title: 日央行高層警惕「非線性」通膨衝擊 預期本周將再度升息
items.title_en: Bank of Japan Officials Warn of “Non‑Linear” Inflation Shock, Expect Another Rate Hike This Week
paras: 根據周一(14日)公布的會議紀錄顯示，一位日本央行官員指出，受進口成本上升和匯率波動衝擊影響，日本通膨率急劇攀升，這顯示在貨幣政策決策時，必須將此類價格波動因素納入考量。
上述言論出自日本央行5月主辦的貨幣政策會議。日本央行已於6月將政策利率調升至 1% 的31年新高，並預計在本周再度升息，以因應日益嚴峻的通膨壓力。
央行通常透過升息來抑制需求驅動型通膨。然而，新冠疫情、俄羅斯入侵烏克蘭、美國提高關稅以及中東衝突等事件，使得人們的焦點轉向了供給側通膨。
負責貨幣政策企畫的日央行執行董事中村康治(Koji Nakamura)在會議中指出，日本國內物價對外部衝擊出現了「非線性」反應，消費者物價對進口價格與匯率波動呈現劇烈上揚。他強調，雖然傳統做法是無視供給面衝擊，但若外部衝擊頻繁發生，就不應將其視為暫時現象，因為這會持續推升基底通膨與民眾的通膨預期。
此外，中村表示，日本同時面臨勞動力減少帶動工資上漲的「慢速人口結構衝擊」，此為不可忽視的結構性因素。
自2024年結束長達十年的超寬鬆刺激計畫以來，日央行已承諾將持續升息。當前緊繃的就業市場、日元疲軟導致的進口成本增加，以及中東衝突引發的燃料價格上漲，均加劇了通膨超越 2% 目標的風險。央行未來需將數據分析與實地調查相結合，以更精準掌握企業與家庭行為的改變對通膨預期的影響。
paras_en: According to the minutes released on Monday (the 14th), a Bank of Japan official said that rising import costs and exchange‑rate volatility have caused Japan’s inflation rate to surge sharply, indicating that such price‑fluctuation factors must be taken into account when making monetary‑policy decisions.

The remarks were made at the Bank of Japan’s May monetary‑policy meeting. The BOJ raised its policy rate to 1% in June – a 31‑year high – and expects to hike again this week to cope with mounting inflation pressure.

Central banks usually raise rates to curb demand‑driven inflation. However, events such as the COVID‑19 pandemic, Russia’s invasion of Ukraine, higher U.S. tariffs and Middle‑East conflicts have shifted attention toward supply‑side inflation.

Koji Nakamura, an executive director in charge of monetary‑policy planning, said in the meeting that domestic prices in Japan are reacting “non‑linearly” to external shocks, with consumer prices spiking sharply as import prices and exchange rates fluctuate. He stressed that while the traditional approach is to ignore supply‑side shocks, frequent external shocks should not be treated as temporary, as they will keep pushing up core inflation and inflation expectations.
Nakamura also noted that Japan is simultaneously facing a “slow‑moving demographic shock” – a shrinking labor force that is driving wage growth – which is a structural factor that cannot be ignored.

Since ending a decade‑long ultra‑easy stimulus program at the end of 2024, the BOJ has pledged to keep raising rates. A tight labour market, a weak yen that raises import costs, and higher fuel prices from Middle‑East conflicts all heighten the risk of inflation exceeding the 2% target. The bank will need to combine data analysis with on‑the‑ground surveys to more accurately gauge how changes in corporate and household behaviour affect inflation expectations.

items.title: 聯準會升息預期升溫推升美元 亞幣普遍走弱、日元維持7個月高位
items.title_en: Fed Rate‑Hike Expectations Heat Up, Boosting the Dollar; Asian Currencies Mostly Weaker, Yen Holds Near 7‑Month High
paras: 受市場對美國聯準會本周升息預期大幅上升影響，美元強勢走高，亞洲貨幣周一(14日)普遍對美元走弱。然而，由於市場押注日本銀行(BOJ)將加速緊縮貨幣政策，日元表現相對堅挺，維持在接近7個月的高位附近。
在美國8月消費者物價指數(CPI)加速上漲後，根據 CME FedWatch 工具顯示，市場目前預估聯準會在9月16日會議升息的機率已升至 86%。升息預期的劇增帶動美元指數上漲0.2%至99.35附近，結束了連續兩周的微幅下跌。
美債殖利率同步受到支撐，10年期美債殖利率來到約4.97%，而對政策利率極為敏感的2年期美債殖利率則保持在4.6%以上。
本周全球金融市場迎來關鍵的「超級央行周」，聯準會、英國央行與日本央行將接連公布最新利率決策。市場目前已幾乎完全消化日本銀行周五將升息25個基點(0.25%)的預期，加上投資人預計日本海外資產可能回流，帶動日元本月累積上漲約 4%。
目前美元對日元交投於154.03附近，維持在接近上周創下的2月以來最高點152.89附近，投機客自2月以來首次轉為淨多頭。
在其他主要貨幣方面，歐元對美元下跌0.3%至1.1564，英鎊對美元下跌0.2%至1.3501。亞幣與周邊貨幣普遍承壓，美元對澳元上漲0.4%、對韓元上漲0.25%、對新加坡元上漲0.16%，紐元對美元則下跌0.5%。人民幣表現相對平穩，美元對離岸人民幣微升0.01%至6.7080，印度市場則因國定假日休市。
此外，中東地區的新衝突引發供應疑慮，布蘭特原油期貨大漲近3%至每桶107.60美元。油價持續穩居100美元上方，恐使能源通膨居高不下，進一步增添各國央行在制定利率政策時的複雜度與考驗。
paras_en: The dollar surged as market expectations for a Federal Reserve rate hike this week rose sharply, causing Asian currencies to generally weaken against the dollar on Monday (the 14th). However, because markets are betting that the Bank of Japan will accelerate its monetary tightening, the yen remained relatively firm, staying near a seven‑month high.

After the U.S. August consumer price index (CPI) accelerated, the CME FedWatch tool showed that the market now estimates an 86% probability that the Fed will raise rates at its September 16 meeting. The surge in rate‑hike expectations lifted the dollar index by 0.2% to around 99.35, ending two weeks of modest declines.
U.S. Treasury yields were supported as well, with the 10‑year yield around 4.97% and the policy‑sensitive 2‑year yield staying above 4.6%.

This week marks a pivotal “super central‑bank week” as the Fed, the Bank of England and the Bank of Japan are set to announce their latest rate decisions. The market has almost fully priced in the BOJ’s expected 25‑basis‑point (0.25%) hike on Friday, and investors anticipate possible repatriation of Japanese overseas assets, driving the yen up about 4% cumulatively this month.
The dollar‑yen pair is trading near 154.03, close to the February‑to‑present peak of 152.89 set last week, with speculators turning net long on the yen for the first time since February.

Among other major currencies, the euro fell 0.3% to $1.1564 and the pound slipped 0.2% to $1.3501. Asian and regional currencies were broadly under pressure: the dollar rose 0.4% against the Australian dollar, 0.25% against the Korean won, and 0.16% against the Singapore dollar, while the New Zealand dollar fell 0.5% versus the dollar. The renminbi was relatively stable, with the offshore yuan edging up 0.01% to 6.7080, and Indian markets were closed for a public holiday.

A new conflict in the Middle East sparked supply concerns, sending Brent crude futures up nearly 3% to $107.60 a barrel. Oil prices staying above $100 a barrel could keep energy‑related inflation high, adding further complexity and challenges for central banks as they set interest‑rate policy.

items.title: 金磚峰會與南方六國首度接入CIPS 人民幣國際支付再擴容
items.title_en: BRICS Summit and Six Southern Nations Join CIPS for the First Time, Expanding RMB International Payments
paras: 2026年9月，全球跨境支付體系出現新動態。第十八屆金磚國家峰會於新德里落幕，會議明確提出深化金磚國家（BRICS）跨境支付合作，推動成員國本土支付系統互聯互通並擴大本幣結算規模。同時，在廈門舉行的第二屆 CIPS 跨境銀企合作活動中，盧安達、土耳其、烏茲別克、馬爾地夫、馬來西亞及喬治亞等六國金融機構首次接入人民幣跨境支付系統（CIPS）。
根據活動數據，期間共有 11 家外資銀行簽署成為 CIPS 直接參與者，4 家境外銀行與 14 家境內銀行完成直參上線。
截至目前，CIPS 參與者已覆蓋全球 133 個國家與地區，服務約 192 個國家和地區的 5,300 家法人銀行，近期單日交易額突破 1.22 兆元人民幣。此外，星展銀行（新加坡）作為首家直連的新加坡銀行，試運行以來累計處理 240 億元人民幣支付；渣打香港則完成了 CIPS 與網聯清算系統的對接，整合跨境與零售支付。
中國國家金融與發展實驗室理事楊濤指出，加強支付合作可降低對美元及西方主導之 SWIFT 體系的依賴，強化金融自主性與抗制裁韌性。他分析，最切合實際的路徑是由雙邊合作逐步擴展至多邊機制。
上海金融研究院副院長劉曉春表示，經由美國清算銀行及 CHIPS 系統進行的美元清算，均處於美國監管視角下。他認為，相較於重新建構獨立的訊息傳遞網路，擴建現有的 CIPS 系統更具可行性。此外，劉曉春評估，在當前各國經濟差異下，推動統一的金磚貨幣並不現實。
中金公司首席經濟學家苗延亮指出，數位人民幣（e-CNY）的可程式化特性有利於大額跨境結算。多邊央行數位貨幣平台 mBridge 截至 2025 年底累計交易額已近 5,000 億元人民幣，其中逾 95% 採用數位人民幣
。然而，苗延亮也提醒，跨管轄區的技術標準與合規體系互通性仍是主要挑戰。
楊濤表示，各國金融體系差異、反洗錢與打擊資恐（AML/CFT）規範不同，以及地緣政治因素，均可能放緩合作落地步調。
劉曉春強調，推動支付合作的關鍵在於尊重市場與商業偏好，而非透過行政手段指定特定貨幣或系統，以利促進區域經貿發展。
paras_en: In September 2026, a new development emerged in the global cross‑border payment system. The 18th BRICS summit concluded in New Delhi, explicitly calling for deeper cross‑border payment cooperation among BRICS members, promoting interconnection of domestic payment systems and expanding settlement in local currencies. At the same time, during the second CIPS cross‑border bank‑enterprise cooperation event in Xiamen, financial institutions from six countries—Rwanda, Turkey, Uzbekistan, the Maldives, Malaysia and Georgia—connected to the People’s Republic of China’s cross‑border payment system (CIPS) for the first time.
According to the event data, a total of 11 foreign‑owned banks signed up to become direct participants in CIPS, while 4 overseas banks and 14 domestic banks completed direct‑participation onboarding.

To date, CIPS participants cover 133 countries and regions worldwide, serving about 5,300 corporate banks in roughly 192 countries and regions. Recent single‑day transaction volume has surpassed RMB 1.22 trillion. Moreover, DBS Bank (Singapore), the first Singapore bank with direct connectivity, has processed RMB 240 billion in payments since its trial launch, and Standard Chartered Hong Kong has completed integration of CIPS with the domestic clearing system, linking cross‑border and retail payments.

Yang Tao, director of China’s National Financial and Development Laboratory, noted that strengthening payment cooperation can reduce reliance on the US‑dominated SWIFT system and the dollar, enhancing financial autonomy and resilience against sanctions. He argued that the most practical path is to expand from bilateral cooperation to multilateral mechanisms.

Liu Xiaochun, vice president of the Shanghai Institute of Financial Research, pointed out that dollar clearing through the US clearing bank and the CHIPS system is subject to US regulatory oversight. He believes that expanding the existing CIPS network is more feasible than building an independent messaging network from scratch, and he assesses that, given current economic disparities, a unified BRICS currency is unrealistic.

Miao Yanliang, chief economist at CICC, highlighted that the programmable nature of the digital yuan (e‑CNY) is advantageous for large‑scale cross‑border settlements. The multilateral central‑bank digital currency platform mBridge has accumulated nearly RMB 500 billion in transaction volume by the end of 2025, with over 95% of that volume using digital yuan.
However, Miao also warned that technical standards and regulatory interoperability across jurisdictions remain major challenges.
Yang Tao added that differences in national financial systems, varying AML/CFT regulations, and geopolitical factors could all slow the pace of cooperation implementation.

Liu Xiaochun emphasized that the key to advancing payment cooperation is respecting market and commercial preferences rather than imposing specific currencies or systems through administrative means, thereby fostering regional trade and economic development.
